title: Long Form YouTube Video Editor
description:
YouTube Video Editor | Real Estate | Long Term



ABOUT THE JOB



I'm looking for a skilled, creative, and reliable YouTube editor for ongoing real estate content, including talking head videos, city and neighborhood tours, lifestyle vlogs, animated map tours, and home tours.



This position is strictly for video editing. No thumbnails, SEO, scriptwriting, channel management, or additional services needed.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



• Experienced in long form YouTube editing, storytelling, pacing, and audience retention. 

• Skilled in B-roll, motion graphics, transitions, music, and sound design. 

•Experience with Google Earth Studio and animated maps preferred. 

• Able to produce engaging, natural, professional videos without excessive effects. 

• Strong communication, creativity, attention to detail, and reliability.



JOB REQUIREMENTS



• Proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software. 

• Professional audio editing, color correction, and 1080p/4K delivery. 

• Turnaround time: 24 to 48 hours per video. 

• Available to edit 1 to 2 videos weekly. 

• Willing to make reasonable revisions.



COMPENSATION AND EXPECTATIONS



• $100 per completed video up to 25 minutes (firm). 

• Videos over 25 minutes: Additional compensation based on length and complexity, agreed upon in advance. 

• Video length: 10 to 60 minutes. • Frequency: 1 to 2 videos per week. 

• Monthly base pay: $400 to $800, plus additional compensation for longer or more complex videos.



I prioritize storytelling, viewer retention, clean editing, and professional quality over flashy effects.

Advanced animations or extensive editing may require additional compensation.



TO APPLY



1.Examples of your best long form YouTube edits, preferably real estate, vlogs, or map tours.

2. Confirmation you accept the $100 base rate and 24 to 48 hour turnaround.

3. Your proposed rates for videos lasting 26 to 40 minutes and 41 to 60 minutes.



Looking for a dependable, talented editor interested in a long term partnership focused on quality, consistency, and YouTube growth.

title: home health administrative asistant
description:
The Home Health Administrative Assistant provides administrative and operational support to ensure the efficient daily functioning of the home health agency. This position assists with patient intake, referral processing, medical record management, scheduling, billing preparation, payroll documentation, and communication with patients, physicians, caregivers, and clinical staff.



The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, dependable, and familiar with home health operations, Medicare documentation requirements, and electronic medical record (EMR) systems.









Essential Duties and Responsibilities



1. Patient Intake and Referral Coordination



Receive, process, and track incoming patient referrals from hospitals, physicians, rehabilitation facilities, and other referral sources.



Collect and verify required patient demographic information, insurance details, physician information, and referral documentation.



Assist with obtaining hospital discharge summaries, medication lists, orders, and other supporting records.



Coordinate with the clinical team to facilitate timely patient admissions.



Maintain accurate referral and admission tracking logs.



Communicate with patients and caregivers regarding scheduling and administrative requirements.



2. Medical Records and Documentation



Maintain complete, accurate, and organized electronic and paper patient records, as applicable.



Monitor documentation for missing signatures, incomplete forms, outstanding physician orders, and other administrative deficiencies.



Follow up with nurses, therapists, physicians, and other authorized personnel regarding outstanding documentation.



Track required admission, recertification, reassessment, discharge, and other clinical documentation deadlines.



Assist with organizing documentation for internal audits, payer reviews, and accreditation surveys.



Protect patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and agency privacy policies.



3. Scheduling and Staff Coordination



Assist with scheduling skilled nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, and other authorized home health visits.



Communicate scheduling changes and patient care coordination needs to the appropriate clinical personnel.



Track missed visits, rescheduled visits, and outstanding visit documentation.



Maintain staff contact lists, schedules, and administrative records.



Escalate urgent scheduling issues and patient-related concerns to the appropriate clinical supervisor.



4. Billing and Payroll Support



Review visit documentation for administrative completeness before submitting records for billing review.



Identify missing or incomplete visit notes and communicate correction requirements to the responsible clinician.



Maintain a tracking log of visits pending documentation, billing submission, or correction.



Assist with preparing completed visit records for billing personnel or the designated billing vendor.



Verify submitted visit records against approved staff schedules and visit logs for payroll processing.



Identify discrepancies in visit dates, visit durations, documentation, or approved pay records and report them to management.



Meet established billing and payroll deadlines.



Maintain confidentiality of employee compensation and payroll information.



5. Physician Orders and Follow-Up



Track outstanding physician orders, certifications, recertifications, and required signatures.



Follow up with physician offices regarding pending documentation.



Maintain a log of orders sent, received, and awaiting completion.



Route clinical questions, changes in patient condition, and medical concerns to the appropriate licensed clinician.



Do not independently provide clinical advice, alter medical orders, or make clinical decisions.



6. Compliance and Quality Assurance Support



Assist with maintaining administrative records required for Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, and applicable state requirements.



Support preparation for internal audits, accreditation reviews, and regulatory surveys.



Monitor administrative checklists for incomplete records and overdue documentation.



Follow agency policies for record retention, privacy, security, and document handling.



Report suspected compliance issues, documentation irregularities, or privacy incidents to the Administrator.



Complete assigned compliance training and maintain required confidentiality standards.



7. Communication and General Office Administration



Answer telephone calls, respond to routine inquiries, and direct calls to the appropriate department.



Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence,
s, faxes, and electronic documents.



Maintain office supplies, administrative forms, filing systems, and staff records.



Assist with preparing reports, spreadsheets, meeting materials, and operational tracking logs.



Provide professional customer service to patients, families, referral partners, physicians, and employees.



Perform other administrative duties as assigned.



Qualifications and Requirements



High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or relevant administrative training preferred.



One to two years of healthcare administrative experience preferred.



Home health agency experience strongly preferred.



Familiarity with Medicare-certified home health operations and clinical documentation workflows preferred.



Experience with electronic medical record systems, such as CradleMRX , or similar platforms, preferred.



Basic knowledge of medical terminology, HIPAA, insurance verification, and healthcare billing processes.



Proficiency in Microsoft Office,
, spreadsheets, and electronic filing systems.



Strong organizational, communication, time-management, and problem-solving skills.



Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.



High level of accuracy, professionalism, confidentiality, and accountability.



Performance Expectations

title: Amazon Product Sourcing VA — Wholesale & Online Arbitrage
description:
Hello! Everpeak Trading LLC is looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Product Sourcing VA for 20–30 hours per week, with the opportunity for a long-term working relationship.



We source products for Amazon’s U.S. and UK marketplace through wholesale distributors, brand-direct suppliers, and established U.S. retailers. This position includes wholesale and online-arbitrage research, along with research supporting retail arbitrage.



You should understand Keepa and a profitability tool such as SellerAmp or Seller Assistant. We value clear communication, attention to detail, and the ability to learn and apply feedback.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Analyze wholesale catalogs and research retail sourcing opportunities.

- Match the exact product, UPC, variation, size, and pack quantity to the Amazon listing.

- Review Keepa history for demand, price stability, competition, and Amazon’s presence.

- Calculate profitability using accurate purchase costs, shipping, prep, and applicable fees.

- Check availability, minimum orders, case quantities, and coupon requirements.

- Flag brand restrictions, MAP policies, sales-channel limitations, and potential authenticity or IP concerns.

- Maintain an organized sourcing spreadsheet and provide a brief update after each workday.

Quality matters more than quantity. We will establish realistic lead targets based on your scheduled hours, sourcing method, and trial results. Explain missing information rather than guessing or submitting an incomplete opportunity as qualified.



To show that you have read the full description, please put AMZ123 in the subject line of your application.



WHAT EACH LEAD SHOULD INCLUDE



Product name, ASIN, UPC, Amazon link, supplier or retailer link, stock status, purchase cost, estimated total costs, profit, ROI, demand analysis, competition, and relevant restrictions. Briefly explain why you recommend the product.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Familiar with Keepa and Amazon product research.

- Understands unit pricing, case pricing, and multipack calculations.

- Comfortable using spreadsheets.

- Reliable internet and availability for 20–30 hours weekly.

- Willing to ask questions, receive feedback, and correct mistakes.

- Able to provide original research and keep business information confidential.

HIRING PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a brief Google Meet interview, followed by a paid trial. The trial rate, hours, and tasks will be agreed before starting.



We will evaluate research accuracy, communication, judgment, and your ability to apply feedback. We will provide our sourcing criteria and review your work during the trial.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:

1. Your relevant wholesale and online-arbitrage sourcing experience.

2. The research tools you can use confidently.

3. Your availability, time zone, and expected hourly rate.

4. A brief explanation of how you evaluate a potential product.

5. Your answer to this question: A supplier sells a case of 12 individual units for $120. The Amazon listing sells a 2-pack. What product cost should be used for one Amazon sellable unit, before other expenses?

6. Your Google/Gmail
 address so we can invite you to a Google Meet interview.

7. Confirmation that you are comfortable completing a paid trial and receiving feedback.

Thank you for your interest in working with Everpeak Trading LLC.

title: HIRING: FEMALE APPLICANTS ONLY — Part-Time Outreach Research Specialist
description:
About the Role



I'm looking for a detail-orientated and results-driven outreach research specialist to help build a high-quality database of potential business contacts for B2B outreach.



Your primary responsibility is to research companies, identify the right decision-makers, and gather accurate professional contact information using my provided prospecting tools.



This role is ideal for someone who is resourceful, organised, comfortable with online research, and capable of working independently with daily targets.



Key Responsibilities



- Research companies and identify relevant decision-makers for B2B outreach.

- Find professionals in marketing, PR, media buying, brand partnerships, and other relevant departments.

- Gather and verify professional contact details, including names, job titles, company information, business
s, and LinkedIn profiles where available.

- Use the provided prospecting tools to find and enrich leads.

- Maintain accurate, organised prospect lists and follow the required data format.

- Provide daily progress updates and submit completed leads on schedule. (every 3 PM Manila time)



Daily Target



70 unique, qualified leads per day.



Each lead must:



Represent a unique contact, not a duplicate.



Have a relevant job title and company affiliation.



Include accurate company and contact information.



Meet the agreed prospect qualification criteria.



Include a source or verification status where required.



Quality matters as much as quantity. Incomplete, irrelevant, duplicate, or fabricated records will not count toward the daily target.



Qualifications:



-Experience in lead generation, B2B prospecting, data research, or contact list building is preferred.

-Familiarity with CRM systems and prospecting tools is an advantage.

- Proficient in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.

- Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.

- Able to meet daily targets without compromising lead quality.

- Self-motivated, dependable, and comfortable working independently.

- Good written English and organizational skills.



**Compensation and Payment:



Compensation will be discussed based on experience and the agreed workload.

Payments are made every Friday.

The prospecting tool will be provided.



Please send the following:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your relevant experience in lead generation or prospect research.

3. The prospecting tools and CRM platforms you have used.

4. Your expected compensation.

5. Your available working hours.



If you are detail-orientated, resourceful, and confident in finding the right decision-makers, I'd love to hear from you!

title: AI Ad Creative for Photochromic Ski Goggles – Static & Animated Ads
description:
DMS makes ski goggles with photochromic lenses that shift from a clear, light-mirror tint to a dark, opaque tint. We’re looking for a creative who can turn our product photos into scroll-stopping static and video ads that make this transition the hero.



Reference

Contact me for the video link. It shows the style we like: a clean studio background with lenses animating from clear to tinted one at a time, a minimal caption, and the product as the only thing moving. We want this look, plus lifestyle and on-model versions.



What You’ll Create



Animated video ads:

Studio product animations in the style of the reference, with the lens smoothly shifting from clear to opaque tint and back

Lifestyle versions with the goggles worn by a skier, where the lens darkens as they step into bright sun

On-model before/after images: the goggles worn by a person in both lens states. In the clear state, the wearer’s eyes should be clearly visible through the lens. In the tinted state, the lens is opaque and the eyes are fully hidden. The pair should be identical except for the lens, with the same person, pose, framing and background, so the two images work as a before/after static and as start/end frames for a video transition.

Static ads: before/after, split-screen or side-by-side showing both lens states, in both product-only and on-model versions

Formats for paid social: 9:16 (Reels/TikTok/Stories), 1:1 and 4:5 (feed)

Text overlays, logo placement and calls to action based on our selling points



What We Provide



Product photos of the goggles in both lens states (clear and tinted), shown on their own. We do not have photos of the goggles being worn. You’ll need to create the on-model images using AI generation and/or compositing.

Our product page with full details and selling points

The reference video

Logo and brand assets



What You Bring



Hands-on experience with AI image and video tools (e.g. Midjourney, Kling, Veo, Runway, Gemini or ChatGPT image editing) plus editing tools (After Effects, Premiere, CapCut, Photoshop or similar)

The ability to keep the product accurate: correct lens shape, frame and logo every time. Our goggles must look like our goggles.

Experience placing a real product onto AI-generated or stock models at the correct scale and fit. Goggles commonly come out oversized, so this needs a careful eye.

The ability to render a convincing see-through lens with eyes visible behind it. AI tools tend to default to opaque mirrored goggles, so this usually takes masking, layering or manual retouching.

A smooth, realistic tint transition, whether from AI start/end frames, masking and color-keying the lens in post, or a mix

Clean compositing: realistic lens reflections, and logos added in post rather than AI-generated

A strong feel for short-form pacing, with a hook in the first 2 seconds

A portfolio with AI-assisted product ads, ideally physical products. Eyewear or apparel is a bonus.



Deliverables (first project)



 video ads, 6–15 seconds each, in 9:16 and 1:1

 on-model before/after image pairs (clear with eyes visible / tinted with eyes hidden)

 static ads in 1:1 and 4:5

2 rounds of revisions

Final files plus editable source files where possible



To Apply

Please send:



Your portfolio, with at least one AI-assisted product ad

A short description of how you’d create (a) the on-model clear vs. tinted images with the eyes visible, then hidden, and (b) the animated lens transition, and which tools you’d use for each

Your rate (per project or per ad) and estimated turnaround

We are a UK-based B2B appointment-setting agency working with clients across a variety of industries, primarily targeting businesses in the UK and US, with occasional European campaigns.



We're looking for an experienced, highly organised B2B Lead Generation Research to take full ownership of prospect research and list building across multiple client campaigns.



This is not an entry-level position or a general virtual assistant role.



We're looking for someone who already understands B2B prospecting, can interpret Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs), and knows how to identify the right companies and decision-makers without requiring constant guidance.

• Research and identify companies matching specific client ICPs.

• Proven experience researching UK and US companies.

• Excellent understanding of ICPs, buyer personas and decision-maker targeting.

• Previous experience supporting multiple clients or industries.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.

• Excellent written English and communication skills

• Comfortable working with Microsoft Excel



Previous experience supporting a B2B appointment-setting or outbound sales agency is highly desirable.



What We're Looking For



We value quality of quantity.



We don't want someone who simply exports hundreds of contacts from Apollo without checking whether they're relevant.



We want someone who understands why a company fits a client's ICP, who the correct decision-makers are, and how to validate the accuracy of the research.

We are looking for someone reliable, experienced and interested in a long-term working relationship.

Deliver it as a reusable preset (Meitu/Wink + Photoshop action) and a one-page SOP so every editor on the team produces the same face. Apply it to photos, reel covers and short video clips, and keep it identical across all four accounts.

Curate and retouch our 6-photo carousels: pick the set, order it, match outfit/lighting/ratio, fix each image.

Choose and edit reel covers/first frames.

Build and maintain our look kit: 2–3 color presets and 3–4 caption/font styles that all our editors use. You’ll replace what we have (it’s dated).

Daily visual QA on the next day’s scheduled posts (crop, exposure, skin, consistency between accounts).

Put together shoot moodboards (outfit, set, pose, lighting references) for our on-site photographer.



What we look for



2+ years retouching for female creators, models or influencers. Show us before/afters.

You’ve done “mixed-race / refined” face styling for Asian creators and can show it holding consistent across a set of 10+ images, not one hero shot.

Fluent in at least two of: Meitu/VIP Meitu, Wink (video reshape), Facetune, Photoshop (Liquify, frequency separation), Lightroom. CapCut for covers.

Video face/body reshape in Wink or Meitu with clean tracking (no warping on movement, hands, hair, backgrounds).

Consistency: her face looks the same in every post, every account, every week.

Taste over tools. You can tell overdone from refined, and you’ll say no to a slider.

Full-time, 40 h/week, Hubstaff time tracking, Wise payouts every two weeks.



How to apply — put SOFT TOUCH as the first line, then:



Link to 5 before/after examples (photo) and 2 short video retouch examples. Female subjects only.

Part 1: We’ll send a 5-image reference board and 5 edited versions of one photo. Rank the 5 by how closely they hit the reference without looking edited, one line each.

Part 2: Edit the two public photos linked below toward the reference board. Send the edits plus your slider values/settings so we can see if it’s repeatable. Photos: [link 1] · [link 2]

Name 3 female creators whose retouch style you’d match for a fitness/lifestyle account and why.

title: Call Center & Operations Lead (Player-Coach) – UK Property Marketplace
description:

About Keylr



Keylr is a fast-growing UK B2B property marketplace connecting property managers with verified trade contractors (plumbers, electricians, locksmiths, and service suppliers) across the UK.



We are looking for an assertive, highly operational Call Center & Operations Lead in the Philippines to take end-to-end ownership of our customer support, supplier onboarding, and marketplace operations.



This is a high-impact "Player-Coach" position. In the initial phase, you will be hands-on managing daily operations—sourcing trade suppliers, chasing compliance documentation, driving job activations, and handling phone support and escalations for both UK clients (property managers) and contractors. As order volumes scale over the coming months, you will recruit, train, and lead a dedicated team of offshore dispatch and support agents underneath you.



Key Responsibilities



1. 

End-to-End Supplier Lifecycle Management (Sourcing to Activation)

Outreach & Sourcing: Proactively contact UK trade contractors (plumbers, electricians, locksmiths, etc.) to introduce them to the Keylr platform. 

Compliance & Onboarding Vetting: Chase missing compliance documentation (Public Liability Insurance, bank/VAT details, trade certifications) via assertive outbound calls and follow-ups.

Supplier Activation: Guide contractors through app registration, train them on accepting work orders, and drive their initial job completions at established rate cards.



2.

Dual-Sided Client & Supplier Phone OperationsInbound & Outbound Phone Support: Handle direct calls,
s, and tickets for both UK Property Managers (clients) and Service Suppliers.

Marketplace Dispatch & Job Matching: Monitor work order queues to ensure emergency repairs and routine jobs are allocated quickly with zero backlog.

Priority Escalation Management: Resolve high-priority issues (e.g., contractor no-shows, urgent client escalations, SLA breaches, billing queries) over the phone with speed and professionalism.



3. 

Support Architecture & Metric Tracking SOP & Workflow Design: Build and refine customer support SOPs, call scripts,
 templates, macro responses, and ticket routing rules in Zendesk/Freshdesk.Metric Tracking: Monitor and improve core operational KPIs: Supplier Onboarding Turnaround, Job Activation Rates, First Contact Resolution (FCR), and CSAT.



4. 

Team Building & Scaling (Phase 2 - Upcoming Months) 

Recruitment & Onboarding: Source, interview, hire, and train junior dispatch and customer support agents as platform volumes expand.

Direct Supervision: Provide day-to-day management, quality assurance (QA) audits, schedule adherence, and active performance coaching for your team.



Candidate Qualifications & Requirements



Team Leadership Experience: Minimum 2+ years managing a team of at least 10 direct reports (10+ pax) as a Call Center Team Lead, Customer Support Supervisor, or Operations Lead supporting Western (UK/US) accounts.



Assertive Spoken English: Exceptional, highly articulate spoken English with a neutral accent—you must be confident handling calls with both UK corporate clients (property managers) and trade contractors.



Full-Funnel Phone Operations: Strong background in handling inbound client support, high-volume outbound phone outreach, and vendor/supplier management.Tech & Systems Proficiency: Hands-on experience with cloud VoIP tools (Aircall, RingCentral), ticketing platforms (Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot), and dispatch/ERP software.



Hardware & Home Office Requirements (Mandatory) Own Laptop/PC: Personal laptop or desktop computer with high-performance specifications (Minimum Intel i5/AMD Ryzen 5 or higher, 8GB+ RAM) capable of handling cloud telephony software, multiple browser tabs, and CRM tools concurrently. Noise-Canceling Headset: High-quality USB noise-canceling headset for clear, professional phone communications.



Reliable High-Speed Internet: Minimum 50+ Mbps fiber internet connection with low latency.Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or power station/generator backup to ensure zero downtime during mid-shift power outages.



Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office setup free from background noise.



What We Offer



Flat Monthly Compensation: $1,200 USD flat monthly contractor rate paid once per month.



Fixed Mid-Shift Schedule: Monday to Friday, UK business hours (No weekend shifts).



100% Remote Work: Save 3–4 hours of daily Manila commute time and work comfortably from home.



Career Growth: Direct path to build, recruit, and lead Keylr’s dedicated Philippine operational hub as the business scales.



Recruitment Process



Stage 1 — Application & Voice Audit: Review of CV, equipment specs, and voice introduction link.

Stage 2 — Initial Video Interview (30 mins): Discussion on phone confidence, client call handling, supplier management, and 10+ pax leadership experience.

Stage 3 — Practical Case Study (30 mins): A brief, real-world exercise simulating UK client/supplier outreach and workflow design.

Stage 4 — Final Leadership Interview & Offer: Final alignment with UK Executive Leadership.



How to Apply (Mandatory Instructions)



To submit your application, please provide:Your Updated Resume / CV (detailing your UK client experience, headcount managed—minimum 10 pax, and home PC/laptop specifications).



1 to 2 Minute Voice Recording (via Vocaroo, Loom, or Google Drive link) answering:"Introduce yourself, summarize your experience managing a team of 10+ call center agents and handling calls with Western clients/suppliers, and explain why you're confident picking up the phone to source and chase UK contractors."

title: FULL-STACK AI ENGINEER — REACT, AI AGENTS, VIDEO AVATARS & SAAS

Paid 2-Week Project | $500–$800 USD | Potential Full-Time Position



ABOUT HIRALO



HIRALO is an AI-powered recruiting technology startup transforming how companies discover, interview, evaluate, and hire talent.



We're building the next generation of hiring intelligence—combining conversational AI interviews, interactive video avatars, data-driven candidate matching, intelligent automation, and seamless recruiter–candidate communication.



Our goal is to move beyond traditional résumé screening and keyword matching. We want to help companies identify real capabilities, transferable skills, and candidate potential using structured data, AI, and explainable recommendations.



We already have an existing platform, product designs, and feature requirements. We're looking for a technically strong Full-Stack AI Engineer to help bring our next generation of features to life.



We're starting with a paid, two-week development project, with the potential to transition into a full-time engineering role.



WHAT YOU'LL HELP BUILD



1. AI INTERVIEWS & VIDEO AVATAR INTEGRATION



We're building an AI-powered interview experience where candidates can interact with a conversational AI interviewer, potentially represented by a realistic video avatar.



Responsibilities include:



• Integrate AI avatar technologies such as HeyGen, Tavus, or equivalent platforms.

• Connect avatars to conversational AI and LLM-powered interview workflows.

• Integrate speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and real-time voice services.

• Handle interview transcripts, structured candidate responses, and summaries.

• Improve conversation reliability, latency, turn-taking, and interruption handling.

• Connect interview results to candidate profiles and recruiter dashboards.

• Support multilingual candidate experiences, including English and Spanish.



Experience with LiveKit, Vapi, Retell, OpenAI Realtime, ElevenLabs, or comparable technologies is highly valuable.



2. DATA-DRIVEN MATCHING & CANDIDATE INTELLIGENCE



A core HIRALO capability is evaluating candidates based on evidence, skills, competencies, and relevant experience—not just résumé keywords.



You'll help develop:



• Structured extraction of candidate information from résumés and interviews.

• Skills and competency matching against job requirements.

• Transferable skills identification across industries and job functions.

• Evidence-based candidate recommendations with clear explanations.

• Scoring approaches grounded in defined, job-relevant criteria.

• Human review and correction of AI-generated assessments.

• Evaluation processes to measure matching quality and reduce unfair candidate exclusions.



We want real, measurable intelligence—not an LLM generating unexplained scores.



3. RECRUITER DASHBOARD & TWO-WAY CANDIDATE MESSAGING

Key capabilities include:



• Real two-way
 messaging within HIRALO.

•
 infrastructure setup and API/webhook integrations.

• Unified conversation history associated with candidate profiles.

• Incoming and outgoing message synchronization.

• Candidate interview history, AI insights, and follow-up tracking.

• AI-generated conversation summaries and suggested next steps.

• Intuitive, responsive recruiter dashboards.



WhatsApp integration is planned for a later development phase.

We're looking for someone comfortable building and shipping complete product features across frontend, backend, and integrations.



Responsibilities include:



• Developing and extending existing React applications.

• Building backend APIs, webhooks, and integrations.

• Working with databases, authentication, and secure data access.

• Integrating third-party AI and messaging providers.

• Handling cloud storage for documents, interview recordings, and other media.

• Writing tests, fixing bugs, and deploying functional code.

• Working with product leadership to prioritize practical, scalable solutions.



TECHNOLOGY STACK



We're particularly interested in candidates familiar with:



Frontend:

• React

• TypeScript / JavaScript

• Next.js or equivalent web frameworks



Backend & Cloud:

• Node.js and/or Python

• Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

• Firebase / Firestore

• Google Cloud Run

• Google Cloud Storage

• REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, and databases



AI & Conversational Technology:

• OpenAI and/or Anthropic APIs

• LLM agents, structured outputs, and tool calling

• HeyGen, Tavus, or similar avatar providers

• LiveKit, Vapi, Retell, or comparable voice technologies

• Speech-to-text and text-to-speech integrations

• Data extraction and recommendation systems



Development Tools:

• Claude Code

• Cursor

• OpenAI Codex

• Git/GitHub

• Automated testing and debugging tools



Not every technology listed is necessarily deployed in our current platform. The engineer should be able to assess our existing architecture and recommend practical integrations without unnecessary rebuilding.



INITIAL PAID PROJECT — 2 WEEKS



We'll begin with a clearly defined project focused on building a functional candidate communication experience.



PROJECT OBJECTIVE:



Enable recruiters to send and receive real
s directly within HIRALO and manage conversation history within candidate profiles.



MILESTONE 1 — 40% PAYMENT (WEEK 1)



• Review the existing application and architecture.

• Set up the development environment.

• Recommend an appropriate
 provider and integration architecture.

• Build or extend the candidate messaging interface.

• Begin implementing real
 sending and receiving.

• Demonstrate initial functionality.



MILESTONE 2 — 60% PAYMENT (WEEK 2)

 integration.

A recruiter can send an actual

• Expanded responsibility across HIRALO's AI platform.

• A potential full-time engineering position with compensation negotiated separately.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development workflows.

• Strong API integration and debugging capabilities.

• Product-minded engineering judgment.

HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with "HIRALO BUILDER" and answer the following:

Have you integrated video avatars, voice agents, or conversational AI systems? Which technologies did you use?

4. API AND MESSAGING EXPERIENCE

, webhooks, or two-way messaging into an application? Explain how you implemented it.



5. AI DEVELOPMENT TOOLS

6. AVAILABILITY AND COMPENSATION

title: Podcast Production Coordinator — Multiple Shows | No Editing | $12–$16/hr
description:
Run a Multiple episode-a-week YouTube video podcast operation (no editing, full-time, long-term)



USD $12 to $16 per hour depending on experience, plus 13th-month pay, paid leave and additional benefits | Mon to Fri, 9am to 5pm Adelaide time



You've run production before. You know what it looks like when it's working, and you know exactly how it unravels when nobody is thinking at least 4 weeks ahead.



Your mission: keep every show at least four weeks ahead, every week.

Multiple episodes a week across multiple shows. Recordings booked months out. Editors who know what they're cutting. Clients who know what's coming. Problems found long before they become urgent.



You won't edit anything. You'll run the operation that keeps 3 to 5 editors and 2 virtual assistants fed, on time and out of the Director's inbox.





WHO YOU'D BE JOINING

Pizza & Property is an Australian property investment podcast and YouTube channel, publishing since 2019, more than 1,000 episodes, and rated 4.8 stars by listeners across Apple Podcasts and Spotify. We've grown into live panel events, an investor education course, and a production studio "P&P Studios" in the Adelaide CBD that now produces multiple custom podcasts for clients alongside our own show. The studio producing custom podcast and YouTube channels is where we're now growing!



The studio runs on systems, not heroics: an Airtable pipeline that tracks every episode from "sold" to "published", Slack automations that help manage workflow with editors, Canva shoot packs for every recording, and an SOP library we're building out. Our production team is already remote. You'd be stepping into a running machine, and once you've learned it, you'd have licence to make it better!



You'll report directly to the founder and Director, Todd Sloan. Short daily calls, headlines not waffle. Nobody's looking over your shoulder, but nobody's hiding either: if a show slips, everyone knows, and we fix it together.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Keeping production ahead. Plan air dates, run the content calendar across multiple shows and protect the four-week buffer.

• Booking every recording. Guests and clients, including interstate clients who fly in quarterly to record three months of episodes in one visit.

• Running the pipeline. Assign episodes to editors and track each one through Airtable from recording to publish-ready.

• Keeping clients organised. Track packages and inclusions, flag renewals two months out, and coordinate agreements and approvals with the Director.

• Setting up every shoot. Shoot packs, ideation sessions, content calls, shoot days, intro recordings, and titles and thumbnails scheduled on time.

• Leading the team. Daily point of contact for 3 to 5 editors and 2 VAs.

• Keeping the Director informed, not involved. Manage the production and bookings inbox, and run one short daily call: headlines, decisions needed, your recommendation.





WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

• Real ownership. The whole operation, not a slice of it.

• No editing. Ever. That's what our amazing editors are for.

• A direct line to the founder. One daily call, no layers in between.

• Long-term and full-time, with 13th-month pay, paid leave and additional benefits.

• Remote, with a fixed rhythm: 9 to 5 Adelaide time, Monday to Friday.

• Systems already built. You inherit a machine, then improve it.

• A front-row seat in the Australian property industry: the guests, panels and clients you'll be booking are the people investors listen to.





YOU MIGHT BE



• An agency production coordinator who has run the schedules for several clients' shows at once but never been handed the authority to own the operation.

• A producer who has worked out that the part you love is the operation, not the edit.

• An operations person from a creator or media business who wants a smaller team and a bigger remit.

• Someone who already keeps multiple calendars in their head and would rather keep them in Airtable.





WHO SHOULDN'T APPLY



• You want to edit. There's no editing in this role.

• You need the day's priorities handed to you each morning.

• You bring problems without a recommended fix.

• You treat "four weeks ahead" as a stretch goal rather than the floor.

• You can't commit to 9 to 5 Adelaide time, Monday to Friday, every week.

• You've only ever run one show. This role is multiple shows and five episodes a week from day one.





WHAT YOU'LL NEED



• Agency or studio experience managing multiple podcasts or YouTube channels at the same time, from recording through to publication is non-negotiable.

• Experience coordinating schedules, bookings, people and deadlines.

• The ability to plan a content calendar with an eye for guest and topic variety.

• Experience working directly with a founder, director or senior executive.

• Clear, confident spoken and written English.

• Confidence with Gmail, Airtable, Slack, Canva and Dropbox. 
 is a bonus; we're moving our file management across to it.

• A reliable internet connection and a quiet space to work from.





HOW WE'LL SET YOU UP

You'll spend your first one to two months shadowing the person who runs this now, learning the process, the team, the clients and the systems. From there you take ownership progressively, and you'll have the room to refine the processes you've inherited. You'll work directly with the Director, with a daily rhythm that keeps priorities and decisions aligned.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Imagine reaching the end of the week knowing every show is four weeks ahead. Recordings are booked. Editors know what they're working on. Clients are organised. Problems were resolved before they became emergencies. And the Director knows what's happening without having to manage a single detail.



That's the difference you'll be making.





THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

• Position: Podcast Production Coordinator

• Location: Remote, with a reliable internet connection

• Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Adelaide time

• Remuneration: USD 12 to 16 per hour depending on experience, plus 13th-month pay, paid leave and additional benefits





HOW TO APPLY

No cover letter. Just four things:



1. Three bullet points, one line each, on why you're the right person for this role.

2. Links to the podcasts or YouTube channels you've managed, with a line on your role in each and which of them you ran at the same time.

3. A 60 to 90 second video or voice note (phone quality is fine, unlisted link is fine) answering: tell us about a time you were responsible for keeping a production schedule weeks ahead. How did you run it, and what happened? No script. We want to hear you, not read a perfect paragraph.

4. Your favourite movie. We're curious.



Applications close 7 November 2026. References will be requested from shortlisted candidates.



If you're ready to run the operation that keeps great content moving, we'd love to hear from you.

No CV

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
We The Wild is an Australian and US plant care brand selling online, on Amazon and through retail partners in both markets. We’re a small, fast-moving team, and this role is central to keeping our best-selling products in stock.



The role

You’ll own procurement and inventory planning for Australia and the US: turning the sales forecast into a purchasing plan, raising and managing POs, and making sure stock lands in the right warehouse at the right time and cost. This is a hands-on role for someone who builds the plan and raises the POs themselves.



You’ll report to our Operations Director and work closely with our USA Operations Manager, our Product team and our warehouse teams in Australia and the US.



What you’ll do



Update the AU and US purchasing plans from the latest sales forecast, monthly or as demand changes

Set and maintain safety stock, reorder points and weeks-of-cover targets by SKU and channel

Raise, issue and track purchase orders; chase delays before they become stockouts

Manage packaging, labels and component supply so production is never held up

Plan inbound freight (sea vs air, consolidation) to balance landed cost against stockout risk

Keep Cin7 accurate for inventory, POs, receipts and landed cost; reconcile with Finance in Xero

Report weekly on stock position, open POs, inbound shipments and risks



What we’re looking for



5+ years in inventory planning, supply planning or procurement, ideally at a consumer products or e-commerce brand

Hands-on experience building purchasing plans from a forecast, including safety stock based on lead times and demand variability

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills: you build and maintain your own planning and landed-cost models

Experience with an inventory or ERP system (Cin7, NetSuite, Netstock or similar)

Working knowledge of international freight, Incoterms and import requirements into Australia and/or the US

Experience across several sales channels (DTC, Amazon, wholesale)

Confident with AI tools for analysis and reporting, with the judgment to check the output is accurate

Organised, detail-driven and comfortable owning outcomes without a big team around you

Clear written and spoken English



Nice to have



Experience with Shopify, Amazon FBA replenishment or Inventory Planner

Experience supplying both Australia and the US



How to apply

Please send:



Your CV

A short answer (in your own words, no AI) to: “Tell us about a time you prevented or recovered from a stockout. What did you see, what did you do, and what was the result?”

Your expected monthly salary and earliest start date



Start your application with the words “Green Globe” so we know you’ve read the full post.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical planning exercise.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Remote (Philippines) | Contractor (full-time)



Location: Remote (Philippines), with in-person team meetups in Manila quarterly

Engagement: Full-time contractor, with paid public holidays, annual leave and sick leave

Experience: 3–5 years of professional design experience and/or a relevant degree

Team: Our growing Philippines-based creative team

About Kitto

---------------

Kitto is a specialist marketing agency working exclusively within the recruitment industry. We partner with recruitment businesses around the world to help them stand out through strategic, creative marketing. Our services include branding, design, video production, animation, and copywriting.



We operate as a fully remote global team, collaborating across time zones to deliver high-quality creative solutions. We embrace AI as part of how we work, using it to work smarter while keeping creative thinking and quality at the centre of everything we deliver.



The role

-----------

We are looking for an experienced Graphic Designer to join our growing creative team. You will play a key role in delivering high-quality visual assets across a wide range of client projects, supporting recruitment brands at different stages of growth.

We are not looking for generic, templated design output. We want someone with a strong eye, clear creative opinions, awareness of trends, and evidence of this in their portfolio.



You will be joining a growing Philippines-based function that is increasingly central to the success of the wider agency, working from home, with in-person meetups twice a year for collaboration and celebrations. You should be reasonably accessible to Manila for these.



What you'll do

--------------------

Design and creative delivery:



- Create high-quality visual assets across print and digital channels, including social media, presentations, brochures, and branded documents

- Design logos and visual identities in line with client briefs and brand guidelines

- Produce assets for both organic and campaign-based marketing activity

- Use AI tools where they add value, for example in ideation, mock-ups, image editing and producing asset variations, applying your own judgement to every output

- Ensure all creative work meets brand, quality, and accessibility standards



Collaboration and communication:



- Work closely with account managers and the creative team to understand briefs, objectives, and timelines

- Clearly communicate design concepts and rationale to internal stakeholders

- Participate in feedback and iteration cycles, refining designs based on client and internal input

- Share what you learn about new tools and techniques, helping shape how the creative team works



Brand and quality control:



- Maintain consistency across all client brand touchpoints

- Apply strong design thinking to solve visual communication challenges

- Manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritising workloads effectively and flagging capacity issues when required



How we use AI:

We use AI to work smarter, not to replace creative thinking. You will be encouraged to explore and adopt AI tools that speed up production, unlock new ideas and raise the quality of what we deliver, while your eye, judgement and craft stay at the heart of the work. We are looking for someone who:



- Is curious about AI and actively experiments with new tools and techniques

- Can use AI tools (e.g. Adobe Firefly, Photoshop Generative Fill, Canva AI, Midjourney or similar) to support ideation, asset creation and image editing

- Applies strong creative judgement to AI output, knowing when to use it, when to refine it and when not to use it at all

- Uses AI responsibly, respecting client confidentiality, brand guidelines and intellectual property



You do not need to be an expert. We care more about curiosity and a willingness to learn than about knowing every tool.



What you'll bring

-----------------------

Essential:



- Design capabilities. You must be confident creating:

- Social media assets for multiple platforms (including LinkedIn)

- Brochures and professionally designed documents

- A wide range of print and digital assets (e.g. event banners, business cards,
 signatures)

- PowerPoint presentations

- Logos and visual identity elements



Skills:



- Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, layout, and composition

- Strong written and spoken English, demonstrated through qualifications or professional experience

- Clear and confident communication, including explaining and justifying design decisions to non-design stakeholders

- Excellent time management and organisational ability, comfortable in a fast-paced agency environment with multiple concurrent briefs

- A growth mindset and a genuine interest in developing your skills with AI and emerging tools



Tools:



- Adobe Creative Suite (particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign)

- Canva

- Microsoft 365 (particularly Word and PowerPoint)



Nice to have. Experience in the following would be an advantage, but is not required:



- Animation

- Photo editing (e.g. headshots, office photography)

- Video editing (e.g. podcasts, social media clips)

- Newsletters and landing pages

- Brand design and development

- Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects

- A strong point of view on design and creative direction

- Awareness of current design trends and the ability to apply them appropriately

- Evidence of continued professional development



If you are developing skills in any of the above, we welcome examples of self-led learning or practical application.



About you

---------------

We are looking for someone who is:

- Collaborative and team-oriented

- Confident but not ego-driven, with strong creative judgement and pride in producing thoughtful, considered work

- Trustworthy and dependable

- Proactive in communicating workload and challenges

- Motivated to grow with the business as we continue to expand, and to keep evolving your skills as the industry and its tools change



Your portfolio

-------------------

A strong portfolio demonstrating a range of design work is essential. It should show more than basic layout work: we are looking for evidence of concept development, visual judgement, and considered design thinking.



Examples of AI-assisted work are welcome. If you include any, add a short note on your process and how you used AI alongside your own design skills.



What we offer

-------------------

- Fully remote working

- Structured contractor engagement with paid public holidays, annual leave, and sick leave entitlement

- A collaborative and supportive team environment

- Exposure to a wide variety of global recruitment brands

- Opportunities to develop skills across branding, campaigns, and emerging tools, including AI

- Support and time to build your AI skills, experimenting and learning alongside the team

- Mentoring and professional support

- Twice-yearly in-person team meetups



Kitto is committed to maintaining fair and transparent holiday and sickness policies that support work/life balance and wellbeing across our global team.

WORKING ARRANGEMENT

 whether an advertised product is profitable, and how do you handle German copy and product-claim checks?

title: Product Infographics Designer  &  Product Video Creator
description:
Overview. 

We're an omni-channel seller of aftermarket parts (Amazon, Walmart, eBay, our own store, and major retail portals). We're hiring two project-based contractors — paid per finished deliverable, not hourly — to produce listing graphics and videos across a catalog of roughly 1,000 SKUs, with steady ongoing volume. All work follows our written SOP and runs through a shared Google Drive; we provide a product datasheet as the source of truth, and we review every file before approval. We hire on portfolio plus a small paid trial — no free or unpaid work.

Long-term, earned. This is a long-term opportunity with steady volume, and we want a lasting partner — but the ongoing relationship is based on your work: efficiency, quality, responsiveness, and service. Deliver consistently and the volume keeps coming.

Role 1 — Product Infographics Designer



The work: design our product-listing infographics — the gallery carousel plus Amazon A+ content — to our SOP. Long-term and high-volume (~1,000 SKUs, in ongoing batches).

What you'll create (per SKU)

• 7-image gallery set: Main/Hero, Multi-angle, Detail call-out, Key dimensions, OEM/Application reference, Buy-it-Right, Buy with Confidence.

• Two renditions of the OEM/Application graphic (a square gallery version + a wide A+ version).

• Two category templates (Buy-it-Right, Buy with Confidence) built once per product category and reused.

How we work

• Google Drive: raw photos in a read-only folder; you upload finished images to “01 – Waiting Review.”

• Datasheet = source of truth: dimensions, OEM/interchange numbers, and applications. Your callouts must match it exactly — accuracy is critical for parts.

• Written SOP: sizes, resolution, color, format, safe zones, brand rules, file naming. Every image follows it.

• QA loop: we review every image; passes move to “03 – Approved,” anything needing changes goes to “02 – Needs Fixes” with clear notes.

What we're looking for

• Proven e-commerce infographic / Amazon A+ portfolio (please link examples).

• Strong Photoshop / Illustrator (or Figma); clean vector callouts and technical dimension layouts.

• Meticulous with text and data accuracy — part numbers and dimensions must be exact.

• Able to follow a written SOP and naming convention consistently across a large catalog.

• Good written English for callout copy. Bonus: automotive / industrial / parts experience.

Pricing — price per image, by type (USD)

Please give your price per image for each type. Some are simpler, some data-heavy. Minor revisions to meet the SOP are included.

Image type Output & size Complexity       Your price / image

Main / Hero 2400×2400,           white bg Simple 

Multi-angle 2400×2400         Medium

How we hire

• Share your portfolio (work you've already completed — please don't create anything new for your application).

• Shortlisted candidates do one SKU as a small PAID trial at your quoted rates; if it meets the SOP, we move to ongoing volume.

• Terms: work-for-hire, full commercial rights on payment; deliver final files plus layered source (PSD/AI). Start your reply with the word “PISTON” so we know you read this.



 Role 2 — Product Video Creator



The work: create short product videos for our listings and ads — same catalog and brand system as the infographics, so the videos feel like one family with our images. Long-term, project-based, paid per video.

What you'll create

• Listing / hero product videos — short highlight videos for the listing gallery (square + horizontal).

• A+ / Brand Story videos — for Amazon A+ modules.

• How-to / installation / fitment videos — help buyers choose and install the right part.

• Social / ad cut-downs — vertical short clips for TikTok /

What we're looking for

• Good written English; able to follow a brand style guide. Bonus: parts / automotive / technical product video experience.

title: Client Success Assistant (Phone + Text Heavy), US Growth Agency, Full Time, $500/month + bonus
description:
Systemize is a US growth agency for med spas. We fill their calendars with Botox and filler patients. We are a small team, and we need one person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks: every lead followed up, every client set up on time, every loose end closed.



This is a phone and text heavy role. You will talk to med spa owners and managers every day, so your spoken English has to be excellent.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Follow up on our leads until they book or say no. Med spa owners who asked about our service get a call and a text from you, on our follow-up schedule, until they book a call with us or tell us no. Every lead, every time. You don't sell. You book the call and our team does the rest.

2. Get our new clients set up. When a med spa signs, we need logins and information from them (ad account, booking system, prices, their past patient list). You track what's missing and follow up by phone, text and
 until we have everything, usually within the first 3 days.

3. Keep clients happy. A short weekly check-in call or text with each client, notes in the CRM, and anything they need passed to the right person on our team.

4. Admin. Keep the CRM clean and up to date, book meetings on our calendar, and keep the task list moving.



PAY

- $500 per month base, paid monthly.

- Plus $25 for every sales call you book that shows up. No cap.



HOURS

Full time, 40 hours a week: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM US Central Time, when med spa owners and their front desks pick up. Only apply if you can work these hours every week.



START

Mid-November 2026, after a paid 1-week trial.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English: clear, confident and friendly with US business owners.

- Organized: you keep a list, you follow up on time, and you never let a task go quiet.

- A quiet, private room for calls, internet of at least 25 Mbps with a backup, a computer and a headset.

- Comfortable with a CRM, Google Calendar,
 and a web phone.

- A plus: customer success, account management, executive assistant, or appointment setting for a US company.



HOW TO APPLY (we only review applications that follow every step)

1. Subject line, exactly: CLIENT SUCCESS - [Your full name]

2. A voice recording, 60 to 90 seconds, shared as a link anyone can open, recorded on your work headset:

   - First, about 45 seconds: tell us about yourself and a job where you followed up with customers or clients.

   - Then leave this voi
 as if it were real: Maria owns a med spa and signed with us yesterday. We still need access to her booking system to launch next week. Leave her a voi
 asking for it (15 to 30 seconds).

3. A short written answer. A med spa owner who asked about our service two weeks ago texts back: "Sorry, been crazy busy. What was this about again?" Write the text you would send back, in 2 to 4 sentences.

4. Answer these in your message:

   1. Your full name, city and country.

   2. Can you work Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM US Central Time, every week?

   3. Your follow-up or client-facing experience: where, how long, what you did.

   4. Which CRMs and tools have you used?

   5. Your internet speed (paste a speedtest.net result) and your backup.

   6. Do you have another job now? Will this be your only full-time job?

   7. When can you start?

   8. Are you comfortable with $500 per month base plus $25 per sales call booked that shows up?



Applications without the subject line, the recording and the written answer are not reviewed.

title: Game Playtester (Windows PC) — Educational Coding Game — Recorded Think-Aloud Sessions, Part-Time Gig
description:
We are Ironline Games, a small US indie studio. We are hiring four part-time playtesters for our educational adventure game White Hat Academy, which teaches complete beginners to code through story missions with a built-in terminal.



This is a gig, not full-time work: roughly 4–6 paid hours per tester over about two weeks, on your own schedule, with the possibility of repeat work on future builds for testers who do great work.



What you will do:

1. Complete a short paid screening exercise ($10 flat, about 60–90 minutes) — details below.

2. Play the game on your Windows PC while recording your screen and your voice (you will talk out loud about what you're thinking as you play — this is called think-aloud testing, and it is the whole point of the job).

3. Fill out a feedback form after each session and report any bugs you find, using our simple template.



Requirements — please read all of them:

- A Windows 10 or 11 PC and a microphone (headset is fine). Sessions are recorded with free software (we'll tell you exactly what to use).

- You must NOT know how to code. We are specifically looking for beginners for three of the four slots — if you are a programmer, this gig is not for you (that's a compliment, not an insult). One slot is for someone with game QA or software testing experience; say which slot you are applying for.

- Strong spoken and written English — you will be narrating your thoughts and writing feedback in English.

- Reliable internet (recordings are large files you'll upload after each session).

- Bonus (tell us if it applies): you own an iPhone (any model running a current iOS). iPhone owners may get extra paid sessions testing our iOS build. If you have one, include the model and iOS version in your application.

- OnlineJobs ID Proof score of 80 or higher.



Pay: $5/hour for playtester slots, $7/hour for the QA slot (screening exercise paid separately at $10 flat, whether or not you are hired for sessions). Paid via Wise within 48 hours of each accepted delivery.



How to apply — follow these steps exactly (applications that skip a step will not be read):

1. Start your application with the word HAT so we know you read the whole post.

2. Tell us: (a) which slot you're applying for (Beginner or QA); (b) your PC specs (Windows version, CPU, RAM); (c) whether you own an iPhone, and if so the model + iOS version; (d) two or three games you've played recently; (e) for the QA slot only: one example of testing work you've done.

3. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to the paid screening exercise. You will never be asked to pay anything, buy anything, or install anything suspicious — the screening uses a video we provide and a writing task.



We reply to every correctly-submitted application within 5 days.

title: Community Appointment Setter – Women’s Health & Fitness
description:
COMMUNITY APPOINTMENT SETTER – WOMEN’S HEALTH & FITNESS



Fierce Women Community is looking for a warm, proactive and results-driven appointment setter to support our online fitness and coaching community for women over 40.



This role primarily involves written conversations: building trust, understanding women’s goals, following up thoughtfully and guiding suitable prospects toward consultation calls.



We’re looking for someone who combines genuine compassion with the initiative and confidence to achieve booking goals.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Build relationships with community members and prospective clients through personalized messages.

• Identify suitable prospects and book qualified consultation calls.

• Follow up consistently without making women feel pressured, spammed or harassed.

• Use scripts as guidance while keeping conversations natural and responsive.

• Work toward weekly qualified-booking goals.

• Show initiative during slower shifts by reviewing outstanding conversations, identifying opportunities and suggesting ways to improve results.

• Maintain accurate CRM notes, follow-up tasks and appointment records.

• Support appointment confirmations and reminders.

• Communicate clearly with our team and provide organized shift handovers.

• Respond to messages and comments across
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.



REQUIREMENTS



• Excellent written English with natural conversational fluency.

• Clear spoken English for team meetings and training.

• Strong empathy, listening skills and the ability to establish trust and rapport.

• A genuine interest in women’s health and fitness.

• Understanding of the challenges women may experience during perimenopause and menopause, or a strong willingness to learn.

• Organized, reliable and proactive, with consistent follow-through.

• Comfortable working toward booking goals while maintaining thoughtful, respectful conversations.

• Able to learn CRM systems quickly and maintain accurate records.

• Coachable and willing to apply feedback.

• Reliable computer, internet connection and a backup plan for disruptions.

• Respect for confidentiality and appropriate boundaries around health advice.



Appointment-setting experience is a strong advantage. Experience in women’s health, fitness or online coaching is especially valuable.



SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



Our community operates between 6 a.m. and 10 p.m. Edmonton, Canada time. You’ll share coverage with two other front-end team members.



Our proposed coverage schedule is:

• Monday–Friday: 6–9 a.m. and 2–5 p.m.

• Sunday: 1–3:30 p.m.

• Saturday off.

• One hour of weekly training/team meeting.



This totals approximately 33.5 hours per week, including training.



This schedule is a starting suggestion and is open to discussion. We can coordinate shifts with our existing team to find a consistent arrangement that works for both you and the community. Responsibilities and response-time expectations during coverage will be agreed before starting.



Please include your availability in Edmonton time and indicate whether you’re comfortable with split shifts. Times follow Edmonton’s daylight-saving changes.



STARTING COMPENSATION



• CAD $150 monthly base.

• CAD $2 commission per qualified consultation booked.

• Initial one-month paid trial, including training on our community, scripts, programs and systems.

• Compensation review after three months, with the possibility of increasing the base to CAD $200/month and commission to CAD $2.50 per qualified booking.

• Further commission growth may be considered as consistent, quality results develop.



Increases depend on performance and business capacity and are not guaranteed. Qualified-booking criteria and payment terms will be agreed before starting.



During the initial training period, we’ll assess reliability, communication, accuracy and progress alongside booking results.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and why this role interests you.

2. Your relevant experience, including any appointment-setting results.

3. Your experience or interest in women’s health, menopause, fitness or coaching.

4. The social platforms and CRM systems you have used.

5. Your availability, time zone and preferred weekly schedule.

6. Confirmation that you understand the starting compensation is in Canadian dollars and are comfortable discussing the role within that budget.

7. A short sample reply to this community member:



“I’ve tried eating healthy and exercising, but my belly fat won’t budge. I’m frustrated and don’t know what to do.”



We’ll provide training on our approach. For this sample, we’re interested in your natural communication style, empathy and ability to keep a conversation going.

description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About Med School Insiders

Med School Insiders helps students become physicians through world-class educational resources, mentorship, and admissions consulting. With millions of followers across YouTube and social media, a trusted reputation in the premed and medical communities, and a growing services and ecommerce business, MSI is redefining what support for future doctors looks like.



About the Role

We are hiring a Marketing Manager to own MSI's core marketing projects end to end and be accountable for the results. You will run paid acquisition, social media and short-form content, community, and
 across three brands: Med School Insiders, Kevin Jubbal MD (KJMD), and Jubbal & Cars (J&C, limited to a monthly metrics review and strategy suggestions).

Paid acquisition is the center of this role. You own Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads, the path from ad click to booked sales call, and the numbers behind both. You also own the social and short-form content engine, working with our Director of Content, Creative Producer, and editors, who produce the long-form content you build from. You will work closely with our marketing strategy advisor, who has the CEO's trust and is consulted before major marketing decisions are final, and with a Google Ads technical specialist who supports you on Google.

This is a lean-forward, take-initiative role. We want someone who hears a half-formed strategic direction in a Monday meeting and converts it into live campaigns, briefs, and dashboards by Friday. If you prefer waiting around for assignments or routing every call up the chain, this is not the right fit.



Key Responsibilities



Ownership of Core Marketing Projects

- Own MSI's core marketing projects from plan to result: scope, timeline, owners, launch, and reporting.

- Convert direction from the CEO and the strategy advisor into executed campaigns, briefs, and timelines.

- Own the marketing calendar against MSI's admissions seasonality (Casper, Interview AI, PREview AI, MCAT, Research, Comprehensive Packages).

- Run the weekly marketing meeting, drive accountability on action items, and surface blockers early.

- Make routine execution decisions without waiting for sign-off.



Paid Acquisition

- Own paid ads end to end across Meta (primary), TikTok, and Google, in coordination with the Google Ads technical specialist.

- Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across all platforms, including medical student forums and niche networks.

- Build campaign roadmaps aligned with product launches, content drops, and seasonal admissions windows.

- Optimize targeting, creative, placements, and bidding to hit KPI goals efficiently.

- Develop full-funnel audiences from cold traffic through retargeting, including custom and lookalike audiences.

- Source and manage UGC creators and any external creative or media-buying contractors.



Funnel, Lead Quality, and Sales Handoff

- Own the full path from ad click to booked call to sales contact, and close gaps between marketing and sales rather than handing off at the form.

- Own landing page and conversion-path design for each campaign: message match, application forms, qualification steps, and CRO iteration.

- Optimize lead quality so the sales team spends its time with qualified leads.

- Design what a lead sees after booking (confirmation flow, VSL or sales asset served on booking) and coordinate speed-to-lead timing with sales.



Budget, Measurement, and Attribution

- Build platform allocations from a monthly or quarterly marketing budget, and adjust spend based on performance, seasonality, and market shifts.

- Forecast CAC, ROAS, lead volume, and MQL-to-SQL, and report risks or tradeoffs in advance, not after.

- Define and monitor key KPIs: CAC, ROAS, CTR, CVR, lead volume, deposit-to-close rate, revenue attribution.

- Deliver weekly and monthly reports with insights and actionable next steps, not just dashboards.

- Maintain tags, pixels, and tracking in Google Tag Manager, and keep attribution clean through WooCommerce and Attio CRM. Own the source of truth.



Social Media and Short-Form Content

- Own the social calendar across all MSI channels and YouTube community posts, promoting MSI courses, services, and Skool.

- Run the short-form engine: select timestamps from long-form content, write hook lines, direct editors on Repurposed Vertical Videos (RVVs), and approve captions.

- Build social campaigns that drive conversions, and test hooks and alternate takes.

- Track platform growth and social trends, and report monthly.

- Ensure comment responses, community moderation, giveaways, and surveys happen on schedule.



Community and

- Own Skool community growth and engagement, including occasional Q&As and Tutor Tuesday.

- Write the weekly newsletter and
 campaigns promoting courses, services, and Skool.

- Build and maintain
 sequences and signup forms in Kit, aligned with paid campaigns and lifecycle triggers.



Organization and Collaboration

- Consult the strategy advisor on major campaigns and strategic decisions before they are final, and bring that input to the CEO alongside your recommendation.

- Keep marketing trackers and SOPs current in Notion, including the MSI Playbook.

- Work with the Director of Content, Creative Producer, design, sales, and ecommerce on unified messaging and shared timelines.

- Brief creative by funnel stage, persona (premed, medical student, parent, residency applicant), and platform. Reject off-brief assets and resource the iteration.



Tool Stack

Qualifications

- 5+ years in performance marketing, with at least 3 years owning - Meta media buying at $20K+/month in spend

- Demonstrated TikTok Ads competence (case studies, not just exposure)

- Track record of owning a marketing function or sub-function end to end, not just executing assigned tasks
