title: PERFORMANCE GRAPHIC DESIGNER — STATIC AD
description:
We are looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to create high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This role is focused on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

• Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

• Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

• Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

• Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

• Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.



REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

• Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

• Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus. 



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: CRO Lead - D2C eCommerce Supplement Brand
description:
Remote · Output-based · Flexible schedule



About us



We are a fast-growing children’s supplements brand built around a simple purpose: helping parents support their children’s everyday wellbeing. We serve families primarily in the United States through our online store and care about the experience beyond the sale—from how we communicate with parents to how reliably their orders arrive.



We’re looking for a CRO Lead to own systematic conversion-rate optimization for paid-acquisition landing pages and the customer journey that follows. You’ll help us establish a repeatable testing program that improves purchase conversion and revenue per visitor while protecting margin, customer understanding, and subscription quality.



What You’ll Own



You’ll be accountable for research, prioritization, execution, QA, analysis, rollout, and learning across the testing program. You’ll work closely with creative strategists and coordinate with campaign, design/development, customer-support, finance, operations, and lifecycle partners as needed.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Analyze funnel performance, customer feedback, support themes, session recordings, and on-site behavior to identify opportunities.

- Maintain a prioritized testing backlog with a clear problem, hypothesis, audience, primary metric, guardrails, and decision rule for each test.

- Align landing-page formats, messaging, proof, objection handling, and calls to action with paid-ad creative.

- Own tests from brief and build coordination through QA, launch, monitoring, analysis, and supported-winner rollout.

- Validate assignment, conversion events, tracking, links, pricing, discounts, subscription behavior, and mobile/desktop functionality.

- Report results honestly as winning, losing, or inconclusive, and maintain a concise weekly update on results, priorities, blockers, and decisions.



What Success Looks Like



During your first 90 days, we expect you to:



- Complete a focused audit and establish baselines for CVR, revenue per visitor, AOV, and funnel progression where data allows.

- Deliver a prioritized testing roadmap and launch the first properly instrumented experiment, subject to access and implementation capacity.

- Build a rolling pipeline with documented hypotheses, QA, analysis, decisions, and credible commercial/customer guardrails.



Ongoing success will be assessed through experiment quality and delivery, purchase conversion rate, revenue per visitor, funnel progression, AOV, and agreed margin, refund, subscription, and customer-experience guardrails. Fixed uplift targets will be set after baseline validation.



What You Bring



- Proven hands-on CRO experience with Shopify DTC/direct-response brands acquiring customers through Meta.

- Evidence of personally owning the full testing cycle, not only advising or supervising an agency.

- Case studies explaining the problem, analysis, hypothesis, implementation, test design, result, uncertainty or limitations, and next decision.

- Strong understanding of ad-to-landing-page journeys, direct-response messaging, mobile UX, customer objections, and purchase friction.

- Practical experimentation knowledge, including traffic allocation, sample-size planning, stopping rules, and inconclusive results.

- Working knowledge of Shopify Analytics, GA4 or equivalent, behavior-analysis tools such as Clarity or Hotjar, and an experimentation platform such as Intelligems, Shoplift, VWO, or equivalent.

- Ability to build or modify landing pages in the agreed stack, write clear briefs, investigate tracking inconsistencies, and coordinate fixes.

- Clear written English, reliable follow-through, and concise reporting.



Useful, but not required: Subscription DTC, supplements, skincare, or parent-focused product experience; testing bundles, pricing, subscription offers, upsells, cohorts, or retention; direct-response copywriting and wireframing; HTML/CSS/JavaScript or Shopify Liquid; international-market experience; and sensible use of AI with output validation.



We’re interested in evidence of what you can do. Your application should show relevant CRO case studies, work samples, or examples and explain what you personally owned.



How We Work



We agree on priorities, responsibilities, quality standards, and deadlines. You’ll be expected to communicate progress, flag blockers early, and bring recommendations when something needs to change.



You’ll have ownership within the agreed experimentation roadmap. Changes to product claims, pricing, discount limits, subscription terms, material spending, or major site functionality require the relevant approval.



Working arrangement: Remote and output-based with a flexible schedule. Overlap with the Founder/creative strategists is not required; the Founder’s active times are GST. 



 Why Work With Us

- Meaningful ownership of a CRO program that is not yet being run consistently.

- Direct collaboration with creative strategists and the team responsible for customer experience.

- Remote, flexible, output-based working arrangement.



Hiring Process



1. Application review

2. Interview with Operations

3. Relevant assessment or paid trial, if applicable

4. Final interview with Founder

5. Offer and onboarding



How to Apply



Apply through our company's form: 

We only consider applications via our form. 



If this sounds like you and the type of working environment where you’ll flourish, submit your application! We look forward to reviewing your application 😊

- Prepare and review monthly Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

- Perform month-end and year-end closing procedures.

- Ensure compliance with US GAAP accounting standards.

- Process weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, and monthly payroll.

- Verify employee hours, overtime, deductions, reimbursements, and payroll adjustments.

- Review payroll tax liabilities and reporting requirements.

- Handle payroll reconciliations, corrections, garnishments, and workers' compensation reporting.

- Work with Gusto, ADP, and other US payroll systems.



3. US Tax Processing & California Sales Tax



- Assist with preparation and review of US individual and business tax returns.

- Review supporting tax documents for accuracy and completeness.

-Assist with 1099 reporting.

- Prepare California sales and use tax reports (CDTFA).

- Reconcile taxable sales, nontaxable sales, and sales tax liabilities.

- Assist with quarterly and annual tax reporting.

- Coordinate missing information and tax-related discrepancies.



 4. Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



- Manage customer invoicing, vendor bills, and payment records.

- Review AP/AR aging reports.

- Reconcile vendor statements and customer accounts.

- Monitor outstanding balances and payment discrepancies.

- Ensure accurate financial documentation and timely billing.



5. Construction Accounting & Administrative Support



- Prepare construction billing, estimates, bids, and change orders.

- Track job costs, labor expenses, subcontractor payments, and project profitability.

- Review construction-related invoices and expense allocations.

- Assist with project billing and administrative accounting responsibilities.

- Maintain organized project records and supporting documentation.



 6. Multi-Client Management & Workflow Accountability



- Independently manage multiple US business clients with competing deadlines.

- Organize and prioritize daily assignments without constant supervision.

- Proactively identify pending work, missing documentation, and approaching deadlines.

- Maintain accurate task statuses and progress updates in the firm's workflow management system.

- Complete assigned work within established deadlines and quality standards.

- Communicate proactively when issues arise rather than waiting for management to follow up.

- Take ownership of assigned client accounts from start to completion.

- Maintain strict confidentiality of client financial information.



 WORK ENVIRONMENT & EXPECTATIONS



**This is a remote position with structured workflow monitoring, but it is NOT a micromanaged role.**



Our firm uses a practice management system to monitor assignments, progress, productivity, and deadlines. However, we expect our team members to manage their daily responsibilities independently.



The ideal candidate must:



- **Be a self-starter:** Take initiative and identify what needs to be done without waiting for instructions.

- **Work independently:** Be capable of completing complex accounting assignments with minimal supervision.

- **Take ownership:** Be responsible for the accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of assigned work.

- **Stay organized:** Manage multiple clients, projects, and deadlines efficiently.

- **Be proactive:** Identify and resolve accounting issues before they become larger problems.

- **Be accountable:** Keep workflow statuses updated and communicate progress or delays promptly.

- **Be resourceful:** Research accounting questions, troubleshoot discrepancies, and recommend solutions independently.

- **Accept accountability:** Be comfortable working in an environment where workflow, deadlines, and work quality are regularly reviewed.



**We provide clear expectations, organized workflows, and management support when needed. We do not provide constant reminders or step-by-step supervision for routine responsibilities.**



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



- **Minimum 4 years of verifiable hands-on US accounting experience, with 4–7+ years preferred.**

- Strong knowledge and practical application of **US GAAP**.

- Advanced proficiency in **QuickBooks Online**.

- Proven experience managing multiple US business clients.

- Extensive experience reviewing, correcting, and reconciling accounting records.

- Hands-on experience processing US payroll.

- Working knowledge of US tax reporting and preparation support.

- Strong AP/AR, general ledger, and financial statement preparation experience.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Proven ability to work remotely, independently, and productively.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

- Exceptional attention to detail, accountability, and problem-solving abilities.



## PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- Previous employment with a US-based CPA, accounting, or bookkeeping firm.

- California CDTFA sales tax reporting.

- ProConnect Tax Online.

- Gusto and ADP payroll systems.

- Construction accounting, job costing, and progress billing.

- Experience reviewing or supervising junior accounting staff.

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent professional qualifications.



## MANDATORY ACCOUNTING ASSESSMENT



**All shortlisted applicants must pass a practical accounting assessment before proceeding to the final interview.**



The assessment will evaluate:



1. **US GAAP:** Accruals, adjusting entries, and proper accounting treatment.

2. **QuickBooks Online:** Transaction classification, reconciliations, and error detection.

3. **Quality Control:** Identifying and correcting mistakes in sample financial records.

4. **US Payroll:** Payroll calculations, deductions, liabilities, and reconciliations.

5. **Financial Statements:** Reviewing Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

6. **Independent Problem-Solving:** Resolving accounting discrepancies without step-by-step instructions.

7. **Workflow Management:** Prioritizing multiple client assignments and meeting deadlines independently.



**A minimum passing score of 80% is required.**



## IMPORTANT: DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NOT QUALIFIED



**We are NOT hiring an entry-level accountant, basic bookkeeper, or data-entry specialist.**



Please do not apply if:



- You have fewer than 4 years of actual US accounting experience.

- Your experience is limited to non-US accounting.

- You only have basic QuickBooks transaction-entry experience.

- You cannot independently reconcile accounts and review financial statements.

- You lack practical US GAAP knowledge.

- You require constant supervision, repeated reminders, or daily step-by-step instructions.

- You are uncomfortable with workflow tracking, deadline monitoring, and accountability.

- You cannot independently manage multiple clients and competing deadlines.

- You are unwilling to complete a practical accounting assessment.



**Applicants who do not meet the minimum requirements will not be considered.**



## HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your updated resume along with:



1. Total years of hands-on US accounting experience.

2. Years of QuickBooks Online experience.

3. Number and types of US business clients you have managed simultaneously.

4. Experience with US payroll, tax preparation, and California sales tax.

5. Experience reviewing and correcting other accountants' or bookkeepers' work.

6. Experience with construction accounting and job costing.

7. Experience working independently in a remote accounting position.

8. Expected monthly salary in USD.

9. Earliest available start date.



**Only qualified candidates with verifiable US accounting experience will be contacted.**



We are seeking a dependable, experienced, long-term professional who takes initiative, works independently, catches mistakes before they become problems, and consistently delivers accurate financial reporting.



**If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this position is not the right fit. If you are an experienced US accountant who takes ownership, solves problems, and delivers results independently, we encourage you to apply.**



Compensation depends on qualifications and the working schedule is 9:00 am to 6:00 pm Monday through Friday US Time zone.  During tax season we do work longer hours.

title: Data Intake & Inventory Manager
description:
Maryah is a data company that works with established businesses to license their operational data to AI companies. We collect business data like CRM records, project management workflows, finance system exports, and internal documents, prepare it, and match it with buyers who use it to train AI models.



The role:

We’re looking for someone to own data intake once a business has agreed to work with us. You’ll make sure we collect the right data, in the right format, and that everything is properly documented in our inventory. Think of it as being an inventory manager, except the inventory is datasets.



What you’ll do:

- Take over from our partnerships team once a business has agreed to work with us

- Guide the business through what to export and how, with clear checklists and follow-ups

- Review incoming data for completeness, quality, and format issues

- Clean, structure, and organize datasets so they’re consistent and easy to review

- Maintain our central inventory sheet: software source, data type, file format, volume, industry, geography, date range, and status

- Flag personal or sensitive information so it can be anonymized before licensing

- Prepare short dataset summaries our team can share with buyers

- Keep intake records and documentation up to date



What we’re looking for:

- 2+ years in a data, operations, or database role

- Working knowledge of SQL and Python for querying, cleaning, and transforming data

- Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills (filters, lookups, pivot tables)

- Comfortable working with files like CSV, XLSX, and JSON

- Familiar with common business tools (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, Asana, QuickBooks, Google Drive)

- Very detail-oriented and organized; you notice when something is missing or doesn’t add up

- Clear written English, since you’ll be guiding business owners through exports

- Can work independently and follow a process without being chased



Nice to have:

Experience with data cataloging or database management

Understanding of data privacy and handling sensitive information

Experience with large datasets (millions of rows)



To apply, send:

Your resume

A quick description of how you’d use SQL or Python to clean a messy CSV export with duplicate rows and missing fields



Include “INVENTORY” in your subject line so we know you read the post.

title: KEP Claimant Outreach Caller / CRM Follow-Up VA
description:
ABOUT THE POSITION



King’s Equity Partners LLC assists eligible owners, heirs and relatives with potential surplus proceeds connected with foreclosure and tax-sale public records.



We are seeking a dependable, English-speaking virtual assistant to conduct claimant outreach using researched leads, approved scripts and our CRM system.



Prior surplus-funds experience is preferred but not required. Clear spoken and written English is required. Spanish is strongly preferred, but applicants are not required to speak Spanish.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Work approximately 20 hours per week.

• Call owners, heirs and relatives using leads and property information supplied by KEP.

• Explain the public-record information and potential surplus amount using an approved script.

• Confirm that the correct owner, heir or relative has been reached.

• Answer basic procedural questions without providing legal advice.

• Handle basic objections professionally.

• Schedule appointments or make warm transfers to management.

• Send only KEP-approved contracts,
s and text messages when authorized.

• Enter complete and accurate CRM notes.

• Schedule and complete required follow-ups.

• Immediately escalate legal, heirship, filing, fee-negotiation and complicated claimant questions.

• Protect all claimant and company information.

• Personally perform all assigned work without unauthorized outsourcing, substitution or credential sharing.



LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS



• Clear spoken English is required.

• The applicant must understand training, instructions and corrections given in English.

• The applicant must communicate with KEP management in English.

• The applicant must write understandable CRM notes,
s and messages in English.

• Clear spoken Spanish is strongly preferred because some KEP claimants are Spanish-speaking.

• Applicants are not required to speak Spanish.

• Spanish-only applicants who cannot communicate clearly in English will not qualify.



REQUIRED CALLING AVAILABILITY



The highest-priority calling window is Tuesday through Thursday from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM in each prospect’s local time.



Calling-day priority:

1. Wednesday

2. Thursday

3. Tuesday



The secondary calling window is Tuesday through Thursday from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM in each prospect’s local time.



Because KEP contacts prospects in both the Eastern and Central time zones, applicants must be available for assigned calling blocks that may include:



• Tuesday–Thursday, 10:00 AM–12:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

• Tuesday–Thursday, 4:00–7:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

• Occasional Saturday testing from 10:00 AM–12:00 PM in the prospect’s local time.



Remaining weekly hours may be assigned to follow-up calls, CRM updates, approved text or
 follow-up, training, performance reviews and other authorized outreach tasks.



Applicants must provide exact availability in U.S. Eastern Time. Do not state only “flexible” or “available anytime.”



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS



• Clear and understandable spoken English.

• Sufficient written English for training, CRM notes and company communication.

• Strong listening and telephone communication.

• Ability to read an approved script naturally without sounding robotic.

• Reliable attendance and punctuality.

• Ability to work the required U.S. calling windows.

• Reliable computer, headset and internet connection.

• Reasonable backup internet and power arrangements.

• Basic typing, CRM and computer skills.

• Ability to enter accurate notes while conducting calls.

• Ability to follow approved scripts, fee language, privacy requirements and escalation procedures exactly.

• Willingness to complete a live English assessment, claimant-call role play and CRM exercise.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Clear spoken Spanish in addition to English.

• Surplus-funds or foreclosure-overage experience.

• U.S. cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

• Experience contacting owners, heirs or relatives.

• Real-estate, legal-intake, collections or consumer-outreach experience.

• GoHighLevel or comparable CRM experience.



POSITION LEVELS AND COMPENSATION



Level 1 — Outreach Caller



• Approximately 20 hours per week.

• $250 monthly base.

• No prior surplus-funds experience required.

• KEP provides training, researched leads, approved scripts and CRM procedures.

• Primary responsibilities include outbound calling, basic claimant explanations, appointment setting, authorized follow-up and accurate CRM notes.

• Level 1 callers may later qualify for Level 2 based on performance, reliability, English communication, CRM accuracy and business needs.



Level 2 — Claimant Outreach Specialist



• Approximately 20 hours per week.

• $250 monthly base during the first 90 days.

• $400 monthly base after successfully completing the 90-day performance review.

• Relevant experience is preferred, but advancement depends on demonstrated performance rather than résumé claims alone.

• Greater responsibility for objection handling, claimant follow-up, appointment management and authorized contract delivery.



COMMISSION AND BONUS OPPORTUNITY



Both levels are eligible for:



• Commission equal to 4% of the consulting fee actually collected by KEP on a qualifying VA-attributed paid case.

• KEP’s continuing high-value case bonus program, subject to its written eligibility and payment requirements.



Example: If a qualifying case produces a $12,500 collected consulting fee for KEP, the VA’s 4% commission would be $500.



Commission is payable only after KEP receives and clears its consulting fee. Recovery timing, case volume and incentive earnings are not guaranteed.



CONTINUING HIGH-VALUE PERFORMANCE BONUS



A qualifying bonus group requires three separate eligible VA-attributed paid cases. Each case must involve at least $40,000 in gross surplus, and the three cases must total at least $150,000 in gross surplus. KEP must receive and clear its consulting fee from all three cases before the bonus is payable.



• First qualifying group: $1,000.

• Second qualifying group: $1,500.

• Third qualifying group: $2,000.

• Every additional qualifying group: $2,000 while the VA remains eligible.



There is no annual reset while the VA remains eligible. One $150,000 case counts as one case, not three.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete:



• A live English-speaking and listening assessment.

• A 60–90-second unscripted English introduction.

• An English claimant-call role play.

• Basic objection handling.

• A sample CRM-notes exercise using fictional information.

• A separate Spanish assessment if the applicant claims Spanish ability.

• Reference verification when applicable.

• A one-week paid trial established through an approved platform milestone or agreement.



Applicants will not receive credit for Spanish ability unless it can be demonstrated during a live assessment.



HOW TO APPLY



Answer every question separately:



1. What country and time zone are you located in?

2. List your exact availability for each day in U.S. Eastern Time.

3. Can you work Tuesday through Thursday from 10:00 AM–12:00 PM Eastern Time?

4. Can you work Tuesday through Thursday from 4:00–7:00 PM Eastern Time?

5. Are you available for occasional Saturday calling tests?

6. Describe your spoken and written English ability.

7. Do you also speak Spanish? If yes, describe your level as basic, conversational, professional or fluent.

8. Describe your U.S. cold-calling, appointment-setting or claimant-outreach experience.

9. Describe any direct surplus-funds or foreclosure-overage experience. If you have none, state that clearly.

10. Which CRM and calling systems have you used?

11. What computer, headset, internet service and backup arrangements do you have?

12. Can you consistently work approximately 20 hours every week?

13. Will you personally perform all assigned work without outsourcing or allowing another person to use your account?

14. What is your earliest available interview date?

15. What is your earliest available starting date?

16. Briefly explain why you are suitable for this position.



Do not provide confidential claimant information or proprietary information belonging to a current or former employer.

title: Weekend Home Care Scheduler
description:
We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and experienced Weekend Virtual Scheduling Coordinator to manage the complex staffing needs of our Northern California branches. You will be the central hub of communication between our caregivers and clients, ensuring that care is delivered seamlessly across six major counties.



This role requires a "problem-solver" mindset—someone who can navigate the nuances of home care scheduling while maintaining a calm, professional demeanor in a fast-paced environment.



Key Responsibilities

Multi-Branch Monitoring: Oversee and manage schedules for all Beacon Home Care branches across Alameda, Contra Costa, Solano, San Francisco, San Mateo, and Santa Clara Counties.



Care Coordination: Act as the primary point of contact for caregivers; assigning shifts, managing cancellations, and ensuring all client care plans are staffed appropriately.



Payroll Preparation & Auditing: * Ensure that "Time In" and "Time Out" data in WellSky matches perfectly with Paylocity records.



Proactively follow up with caregivers regarding missed punches or discrepancies.

Prepare weekly caregiver payroll exports/reports with high accuracy.



Communication Management: Handle high-volume inbound and outbound calls with professionalism and empathy.



Issue Resolution: Independently address scheduling conflicts and caregiver concerns. Use sound judgment to escalate high-priority issues to the Manager when necessary.



Documentation: Maintain meticulous notes on all interactions and schedule changes to ensure a clear audit trail for the team.



Required Qualifications & Skills

Industry Experience: Previous experience specifically as a scheduler in a Home Care or Home Health setting is mandatory.



Technical Proficiency: Professional-level experience with the following tools is highly preferred:

WellSky (Scheduling/CRM)

Paylocity (Timekeeping/Payroll)

Microsoft Teams (Internal Communication)

Clerk (SMS/Communication)



PST Availability: Must be able to work consistently FRI, SAT, SUN AND MONDAY, PST time. 42 hrs in total a week.



Soft Skills:

Detail-Oriented: A sharp eye for numbers and data reconciliation between two different software platforms.

Proactive Nature: You don't wait for a shift to go unfilled; you anticipate needs before they become crises.

Elite Organization: Ability to track moving parts across six different geographic regions.

Independent Problem Solver: A "figure-it-out" attitude when faced with last-minute call-outs or logistical hurdles.

title: Full-Time Acquisitions Real Estate VA (Negotiation & Closing)

Compensation

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction about your real estate VA experience, particularly your experience with acquisitions, negotiation, objection handling, and closing deals.

To start, you will not be writing scripts or coming up with ideas because I will have content to give you, but you will need to take the footage and turn It into captivating content via capcut, higgsfield, claude or any editing program.  • Go through my raw footage and pull out the strongest clips, hooks, and moments

• Create Carousels and written content in Canva

 • Write captions and post every day to Instagram, LinkedIn, X 
), and YouTube Shorts

How to apply

Start your application with the word “Discipline” so I know you read this all the way through. 

Applications without it will not be reviewed. After that, please send:

 1. A short Loom video, under three minutes, walking me through a social account or content calendar you have managed

 2. Links to three short-form videos you edited

 3. How many hours a week you can work and what time of day you prefer

 

The strongest applicants will get a short paid test using my real footage

title: Head of Finance
description:
Reports to: Managing Director. Dotted line to the Chief Executive of the membership business for its priorities

Works with: Finance Lead, Operations. Finance Assistant via the Finance Lead. Operations leads on budgets

Hours: Full time, 40 hours per week

Engagement Independent contractor, Philippines based, remote, Australian business hours overlap

Kindly attach your resume for review.



About the group

A privately owned Australian group of four operating businesses, with a finance team based in the Philippines working to Australian business hours. One of the businesses is a membership organisation funded by supplier rebate income, which is about to take on two new activities: holding and paying supplier accounts on behalf of its members, and offering a paid service tier on top of free membership. The finance function is being strengthened to support that growth.



Purpose

Lead the finance function across the group. Bring the four entities into one clean financial picture with each standing on its own numbers, own budgets and forecasts for all of them, set credit control policy, and be the finance owner of the membership business’s new commercial programs: consolidated supplier accounts, the paid service tier and the rebate P&L. Build the models that say whether things work, the operations that make them run and the controls that stop them going wrong, then hand the running to operations with a documented process while staying accountable for the numbers.



Responsibilities (accountable)

Group consolidation and reporting standards

•Monthly consolidated reporting across the four entities, each on its own numbers; intercompany reconciled, no unexplained balances.

•One set of reporting standards, controls and a month-end calendar for all entities.

•Audit, tax and statutory compliance across entities, including ATO obligations (BAS, IAS, STP, payroll finalisation). Accountant, auditor and bank relationships.

Budgets and forecasting, all entities

•Annual budget and quarterly reforecast for every entity and the group view, built from definitions not rolled forward, including capital equipment replacement allowances.

•The Finance Lead builds the entity detail with operations; this role is accountable for the output.

Australian payroll compliance and Philippines contractor payments

•Accountable for Australian payroll compliance (ATO, STP, superannuation, payroll tax where applicable) and for the Philippines contractor payment framework: agreements on file, agreed hours and rates, any withholding or documentation the contracts require. Approves each payroll run and contractor payment run before it is paid.



Credit control policy

•Credit terms by customer type, credit limits, stop-supply rules, the point at which an account goes to formal recovery.

•One aged debtors report for all entities to the Managing Director every month.

Membership business finance

•Monthly P&L, cash and variance, presented to the Managing Director and Chief Executive and explained.

•Rebate income by supplier, reconciled to supplier statements and member purchasing data. Breakeven and the membership growth needed to reach it.

•Cost and return on member programs so the Chief Executive can see what each costs per member and what it brings in.

Consolidated supplier accounts (design and pilot)

•Design the finance operations before anything is built: invoice intake and matching, member statement cycle, collections and direct debit mandates, supplier payment runs, rebate netting, reconciliations, month-end close.

•Credit limits per member, exposure model (average monthly supplier spend times members on the platform), bad debt watch, suspension path.

•Specify what the platform must produce for finance and test it before go-live. Run the pilot, document, hand to the Finance Lead.

Paid service tier and supplier economics

•Business case and pricing model: fee on managed spend not revenue, a net-ahead test for every member, cash flow timing so the business never funds the gap between collecting and paying. Say plainly if the fee exceeds the benefit for a member type.

•What consolidated prompt payment is worth to a supplier and what additional discount it should buy, additive to the existing rebate.

•The numbers behind every supplier negotiation and renewal; financial pages for the board and partners.

Backup responsibilities (Finance Lead’s areas)

•Able to run month-end close for every entity, collections operations, transaction processing and the live consolidated accounts function. Covers in full during the Finance Lead’s leave.



What this role is not

•Not the commercial designer of the new programs; those decisions sit with the Managing Director and Chief Executive. This role builds and stress tests the numbers and the operations underneath them.

•Not a technology role. It specifies what finance needs from the platform and tests what is delivered.

•Not an advocate for any one entity inside another. Where one group business supplies another, it is treated as any other supplier in every model.



Measures

•Group consolidation delivered monthly; no unexplained intercompany balances within three quarters.

•Membership business reported on its own numbers by the agreed day; rebate P&L closed and maintained.

•Budgets and reforecasts delivered to the calendar for every entity.

•Consolidated accounts process documented, tested and running through pilot, reconciled monthly.

•Paid tier business case and pricing model delivered on real inputs and defensible with the board.

•Debtor days and overdue balances (60 and 90 days) by entity against targets; bad debt written off.

•Owner and backup list in place; leave covered without a gap.



Experience

•Multi-entity finance management, consolidation and intercompany reconciliation. Full set of accounts through to audit, with Australian compliance (ATO, BAS, STP).

•Credit control and collections at scale. Xero essential; NetSuite and MYOB useful. Advanced Excel modelling.

•Leading a finance team across locations; presenting to directors and boards. Membership, rebate or multi-site retail experience useful, not required.

title: Senior Structural / Product Development Engineer – Modular Steel Building System
description:
REMOTE – PROJECT-BASED (MILESTONES)



STEEL ONE™ is developing a patent-pending modular structural building platform based on precision-manufactured steel cage modules (the "Structural Cage-Block"). We are looking for a senior engineer who combines structural analysis with product-development thinking to help turn the current concept into an engineerable, testable prototype.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Develop and critique the Structural Cage-Block load path and structural architecture

- Evaluate member sizing, local reinforcement, bracing and module-to-module load transfer

- Develop vertical, lateral, corner, opening and foundation connection concepts

- Perform or direct preliminary FEA and structural calculations

- Define structural interfaces for doors, windows and façade systems

- Coordinate closely with manufacturing and façade specialists

- Identify technical risks and recommend prototype tests



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Degree in Civil/Structural or Mechanical Engineering

- Strong structural steel engineering background

- Experience with welded and mechanically connected steel assemblies

- Experience with modular, prefabricated or industrialized construction (strongly preferred)

- Professional use of CAD and structural/FEA software (e.g. SAP2000, ETABS, STAAD, Ansys, SolidWorks)

- Working knowledge of AISC, AWS, ASTM, IBC/ASCE 7 and/or Eurocodes

- Ability to produce fabrication-oriented drawings and specifications

- Good written English



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

- Mechanical/product engineering background

- Steel cassettes, frames, racks, curtain-wall support systems or modular structures

- Taking hardware from concept through prototype testing and design revision



PHASE 1 DELIVERABLES

- Engineering review memo with the major technical risks

- Recommended cage configuration and preliminary member strategy

- Preliminary connection concepts

- Initial CAD model and structural analysis/FEA plan

- Prototype test recommendations and development roadmap



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "STEEL CAGE" so we know you read this post. Then include:

1. Your degree, licenses/certifications and years of relevant experience

2. Examples (photos, drawings or links) of fabricated structural products or assemblies you personally engineered

3. Your preferred structural and CAD/FEA software

4. A brief explanation of how you would validate a new modular steel structural concept before fabrication

5. The three biggest technical risks you would expect in a modular steel cage-block system

6. Your hourly rate or a fixed-fee proposal for Phase 1



Applications without the words "STEEL CAGE" or without real project examples will not be considered.



ENGAGEMENT

Milestone-based. Phase 1 is a paid technical review and critique, followed by a clearly defined development plan before deeper engineering work begins. Strong performers will continue into later phases (detailed CAD, FEA, connections and prototype drawings).



CONFIDENTIALITY

STEEL ONE™ is proprietary, patent-pending technology. Initial discussions are non-confidential. Detailed geometry, connection concepts and engineering data will be shared only after an NDA/IP agreement is signed.

title: Manufacturing / DFM Engineer – Steel Fabrication & Prototype-to-Production
description:
REMOTE – PROJECT-BASED (MILESTONES)



STEEL ONE™ is developing a patent-pending modular structural building platform based on precision-manufactured steel cage modules (the "Structural Cage-Block"). We are looking for a manufacturing engineer to make the Cage-Block practical, repeatable and economical to fabricate. The role focuses on Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/DFA), fabrication sequencing, fixtures, tolerances and the transition from prototype to scalable production.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Review cage geometry for manufacturability and production cost

- Recommend tube/profile laser, sheet laser, bending, machining, welding and fastening strategies

- Develop tolerance schemes and a datum/control-point strategy

- Recommend self-fixturing tabs, slots, jigs and assembly fixtures where appropriate

- Reduce part count, weld length, handling steps and fabrication time

- Plan prototype, pilot and future automated production workflows

- Support supplier/fabricator selection and technical RFQs



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering

- Hands-on DFM/DFA experience with fabricated steel products

- Experience with laser-cut tube/profile and sheet-metal production

- Strong understanding of MIG/MAG/TIG and robotic welding

- Knowledge of fixtures, jigs, weld distortion and dimensional inspection

- Experience producing BOMs, process plans and fabrication drawings

- Good written English



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

- Automation / robotic welding integration

- Lean manufacturing, takt-time and production-line design

- Structural fabrication quality systems and traceability



PHASE 1 DELIVERABLES

- DFM review with prioritized redesign recommendations

- Proposed manufacturing process flow

- Preliminary fixture/tooling strategy

- Tolerance and inspection plan

- Prototype and pilot-production cost drivers

- Roadmap toward scalable production



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "DFM STEEL" so we know you read this post. Then include:

1. Your degree and years of relevant manufacturing experience

2. Examples (photos, drawings or links) of fabricated products you helped industrialize

3. Your experience with tube laser, bending, welding and fixtures

4. Examples of cost or cycle-time reductions you achieved

5. Whether you have worked with prototype shops and contract manufacturers

6. The three biggest manufacturing risks you would expect in a modular welded steel cage system

7. Your hourly rate or a fixed-fee proposal for Phase 1



Applications without the words "DFM STEEL" or without real project examples will not be considered.



ENGAGEMENT

Milestone-based. Phase 1 is a paid DFM review and critique,

title: Façade / Structural Glazing Engineer – Modular Glass Façade System
description:
REMOTE – PROJECT-BASED (MILESTONES)



STEEL ONE™ is developing a patent-pending modular structural building platform based on precision-manufactured steel cage modules (the "Structural Cage-Block"). The system includes transparent and opaque façade options that attach to a standardized structural cage. We are looking for a façade engineer with structural glazing / curtain-wall experience to develop a safe, drained, thermally isolated and replaceable glass interface.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Develop glazing support and attachment concepts for STEEL ONE™ modules

- Advise on insulated, laminated, tempered/heat-strengthened and low-iron glass configurations

- Evaluate wind pressure, glass edge support, deflection and movement requirements

- Develop gasket, structural silicone, pressure-plate or mechanical-retention concepts as appropriate

- Design for drainage, pressure equalization, weather sealing and panel replacement

- Coordinate thermal breaks between the glazing frame and the structural steel cage

- Help define a universal façade attachment interface that can support multiple skin materials



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Degree in Civil/Structural, Mechanical or Façade Engineering (or Architecture with façade specialization)

- Professional experience in curtain wall, structural glazing or architectural façade engineering

- Knowledge of IGUs, laminated safety glass, heat-treated glass, sealants and glazing gaskets

- Understanding of wind loading, thermal movement, water penetration and façade deflection

- Ability to produce engineering details and coordinate with structural/product engineers

- Good written English



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

- Unitized curtain-wall design

- Custom curved/slumped glass systems

- Air, water and structural performance testing of façades



PHASE 1 DELIVERABLES

- Preliminary glazing-system section details

- Recommended glass and frame concepts for prototype testing

- Interface requirements between the glass system and the cage

- Drainage / weather-seal strategy

- Preliminary façade test plan



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "GLASS CAGE" so we know you read this post. Then include:

1. Your degree and years of relevant façade/glazing experience

2. Completed curtain-wall or glazing projects (photos, drawings or links) and your exact role on each

3. Your experience with IGUs, laminated glass and structural silicone / mechanical retention

4. The software and analysis tools you use

5. A brief explanation of how you would design a replaceable glass panel on a modular steel structural cage

6. The three biggest technical risks you would expect in this façade interface

7. Your hourly rate or a fixed-fee proposal for Phase 1



Applications without the words "GLASS CAGE" or without real project examples will not be considered.



ENGAGEMENT

Milestone-based. Phase 1 is a paid technical review and concept development, followed by a clearly defined development plan before deeper engineering work begins. Strong performers will continue into later phases (detailed façade drawings, prototype and testing support).



CONFIDENTIALITY

STEEL ONE™ is proprietary, patent-pending technology. Initial discussions are non-confidential. Detailed geometry, connection concepts and engineering data will be shared only after an NDA/IP agreement is signed.

title: Appointment Setter for ONE Med Spa (Botox and Filler), Full Time, $500/month + $15 per booking
description:
Systemize is a US growth agency. We fill med spa calendars with Botox and filler patients: we run the ads, and our booking team calls every person who asks about a treatment and books them in.



We are hiring an appointment setter for ONE med spa client. You set for that one clinic only, so you learn it inside out (its injectors, prices, deposit policy and calendar) and become the best booker it has ever had.



Every lead is warm. You only call people who just filled out a form asking about Botox or filler. No cold calling, ever.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call every new lead within minutes. This is the most important part of the job. Our target is under 5 minutes from the form to your first call (double dial, voi
, then a text).

- Run a short phone consultation, not a pushy pitch: why they reached out, which area they want to treat, whether they've had Botox or filler before, and what worries them. Listen, make them comfortable, sum it back.

- Book them with a deposit into the clinic's calendar: two real time options, a calm explanation of the deposit, and a secure payment link by text while you stay on the line.

- Follow up on our cadence with everyone you didn't reach, and call back on time, every time.

- Log every call, voi
, text and booking in our CRM right away.

- Call and text only from the US number we give you. Never your personal phone.



You are not medical staff and you never give medical advice. Health questions go to the clinic's injectors. We train you on exactly what you can and can't say.



PAY

- $500 per month base, paid monthly.

- Plus $15 for every appointment you book with a deposit. No cap.

- A booking counts if the patient shows up, reschedules (counted once), or no-shows or cancels late and the clinic keeps the deposit. It doesn't count if they cancel and get the deposit back, were booked without a deposit, or were already booked.

- At 20 bookings a month you earn $800, at 30 $950, at 40 $1,100, at 50 $1,250.



HOURS

Full time, 40 hours a week: Tuesday to Saturday, 1 PM to 9 PM US Central Time. This is when most patients fill out forms. Only apply if you can work these hours every week.



START

Mid-November 2026, after a paid 1-week trial.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken English: clear, warm, easy for an American caller to understand.

- A quiet, private room for calls. Patients share private things with you.

- Internet of at least 25 Mbps, plus a backup (mobile data or a second line).

- A computer and a headset with a microphone.

- Comfortable using a CRM, a calendar and a web phone at the same time.

- A plus: appointment setting or phone sales, front desk at a clinic, dental office, salon or med spa, or anything in skin care.

- Calm, patient, coachable, and never pushy.



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- One clinic, so you can get really good at it.

- Warm leads only.

- Full training: our call playbook, Med Spa 101, what you can and can't say, objections and FAQs.

- A paid 1-week trial with call reviews and coaching.

- A US number, a CRM login with everything about your clinic, and the clinic's calendar.



HOW TO APPLY (we only review applications that follow every step)

1. Subject line, exactly: ONE CLINIC SETTER - [Your full name]

2. A voice recording, 60 to 90 seconds, shared as a link anyone can open (Vocaroo, Google Drive or similar), recorded on the headset you would use for work:

   - First, about 45 seconds: tell us about yourself and the last job where you talked to customers on the phone.

   - Then leave this voi
 as if it were real: Sarah filled out a form about Botox 2 minutes ago at "Glow Med Spa". You called twice and she didn't pick up. Leave her the voi
 you would leave (15 to 30 seconds).

3. A short written answer. Sarah picks up and says: "How much is Botox? And honestly I'm nervous it'll look fake." Botox is $13 per unit and the deposit is $50. Write exactly what you would say back, in 3 to 6 sentences.

4. Answer these in your message:

   1. Your full name, city and country.

   2. Can you work Tuesday to Saturday, 1 PM to 9 PM US Central Time, every week?

   3. Your phone experience: where, how long, what you did. Any numbers you're proud of?

   4. Any experience in a clinic, med spa, salon or skin care?

   5. Your internet speed (paste a speedtest.net result) and your backup.

   6. Your headset model, and where you will take calls.

   7. Which CRMs or booking systems have you used?

   8. Do you have another job now? Will this be your only full-time job?

   9. When can you start?

   10. Are you comfortable with $500 per month base plus $15 per deposit booking?



Applications without the subject line, the recording and the written answer are not reviewed.

Build accurate PPO benefit breakdowns in Open Dental (maximums, deductibles, frequencies, waiting periods, coverage percentages, and ortho benefits such as lifetime maximums, age limits, and payment frequency)

Prepare routing slips 2 days ahead so insurance details match the schedule, and check the schedule throughout the day for newly added appointments

Keep patient insurance information clean and current (subscriber details, plan updates, coordination of benefits)

Alert the office and call center to inactive, terminated, or changed coverage so patients can be contacted before their visit



Payment posting and account accuracy



Post PPO and Denti-Cal insurance payments (EOBs/ERAs) quickly and accurately, and keep patient ledgers clean and balanced

Post 
 payments and keep payment records clean

Upload and attach eligibility and supporting documentation to the correct patient charts and claims



Orthodontic billing



Submit and track orthodontic insurance claims for PPO patients (initial banding, monthly/periodic billing, retention)

Monitor ortho payment plans and patient balances, and flag missed payments or discrepancies

Learn our Denti-Cal ortho process over time (we’ll train you)



Claims follow-up and audits



Work denials, rejections, and aging AR; follow up with carriers and submit appeals when needed

Audit claims and balances proactively so errors are caught early, not “fixed later”

Double-check Denti-Cal and PPO policies to prevent denials and appeals

Keep clear notes in Open Dental, close every loop with the offices, and escalate chart, billing, or documentation issues quickly and clearly



What Good Looks Like (our READY standard)



Routing Slips Prepared: Every patient’s eligibility is verified before they arrive, and routing slips match the schedule so the office can execute immediately.

Ensure Schedule & Record Accuracy: Extreme attention to detail. Insurance and billing information is entered correctly and readable for the office.

Audit & Bill Daily: Breakdowns are accurate, claims are correct, balances make sense, and errors are caught early.

Dedicated to the Office: Strong ownership mindset. You keep a running task list, close loops with confirmation, and take work off the manager’s plate.

Yield Maximum Production: Fewer eligibility surprises, fewer denials, fewer billing mistakes, and no production left on the table.



Requirements



2+ years of US dental insurance experience, including eligibility verification, benefit breakdowns, and payment posting (PPO required)

US orthodontic billing experience and a strong understanding of how ortho insurance pays over the course of treatment

Experience working denials, appeals, and AR follow-up with US carriers

Comfortable with payer portals and phone verifications

Excellent written and spoken English

Able to work ahead of the schedule and manage high daily volume without sacrificing accuracy

Proactive and dependable in a remote setting: you close loops and confirm your work

Reliable computer, fast stable internet, and a quiet workspace with backup power and internet

Available to work US Pacific Time hours



Nice to Have



Denti-Cal/Medi-Cal experience (strong plus)

Open Dental experience

Experience with patient financing or payment plan platforms such as 

A dental nerd at heart who wants to understand not just the “what” but the “why” behind our policies



Why Join Us



Long-term, stable full-time role

Paid training with a supportive, experienced team



How to Apply

Send the following:



Your resume

A short summary of your dental insurance and ortho billing experience (practices, software used, typical daily volume)

This is an active, guest-facing position that requires sound judgment, attention to detail, and ownership of follow-through.

 dashboards

- Build a database of potential partners in Edmonton (realtors, moving companies, rental and property managers, condo and office buildings) in a shared spreadsheet. We will send partnership offers to them ourselves.

- Find local
 groups and 
 communities where we can be present and find clients

- Watch competitors' social media for interesting ideas (post and video formats)



DON'T WORRY ABOUT THE CRM

Our CRM is simple: a board with cards, and you move a card from one stage to the next. No technical skills needed. Before your trial starts, we send you a short guide with screenshots and easy videos showing exactly where to click. If you're ever unsure, message the On-Site Manager or me directly.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

- No required cold calling or sales calls. (Finding new clients is optional and earns bonuses, see Pay.)

- No taking or creating orders: orders arrive and are processed automatically

- Your job is coordination: existing clients, solving issues, coordinating cleaners and keeping the process moving



WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You report to our On-Site Manager in Edmonton and communicate by text in
. You are never on your own: a question can always be sent to the On-Site Manager or the owner. We're a small, friendly team that values clear communication and honesty.



WHAT TO EXPECT

- At the start there are only a few orders, so some days may have no calls at all. On those days you work through the background task list.

- Your work is evaluated using automated tracking of your activity: posts, response speed, review handling. It's a simple way to measure results, and we want you to know about it from day one.



REQUIREMENTS

- English B2 or higher, spoken and written (short interview in English)

- Experience managing social media accounts

- Calm, polite phone manner

- Own computer, headset with microphone, stable internet (a backup connection is preferred)



SCHEDULE

Monday to Friday, 8 hours/day, approx. 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Edmonton time (about 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila time, one hour later in winter).



PAY

- $500/month, paid on the 1st and 15th ($250 each)

- The first 2 weeks are a paid trial at the same rate. If it turns out we are not a good fit for each other, we may end the cooperation after the trial.

- $20 bonus for every new private client YOU find, for example through social media comments, community groups or other pages. Clients who simply contact us through our own ads or pages don't count.

- $100 bonus for every commercial contract YOU bring. Look for local businesses with a physical location: offices, salons, nail studios, cafes, restaurants, fast food, clinics, gyms, and so on. You can contact them and offer our services. If a business is interested, add it to the lead form; our On-Site Manager will visit for an estimate. Paid after the contract is signed and the first payment is received. Realtors, moving companies and similar partners are handled by us and don't count for this bonus.

- A bonus counts only if you add the person or business (name and phone number) to our lead form BEFORE they place their first order. The form timestamp is the proof. Bonuses are paid with your next paycheck after the client's first payment is received. We may contact referred clients to confirm how they found us. False or backdated entries mean no bonus and may end the contract.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send us the following (voice messages as audio files or as a link, about 30-60 seconds each):



1. VOICE: Introduce yourself and tell us why we should choose you.



2. WRITTEN: A client left a 2-star review: "The cleaner arrived 30 minutes late." Write a public reply.



3. VOICE: Your cleaner has just told you she will be 30 minutes late. Say what you would tell the client, as if you were calling them.



4. VOICE: A client booked a cleaning for a time when all our cleaners are already busy. You need to call them and solve it. Say what you would tell the client.



5. VOICE: Your cleaner texts you: "The client's cat ran out of the open door and I can't find it. The client is at work." What do you do, and what do you tell the client?

title: Cost and Change Management
description:
NLS is looking for Cost and Change Specialists to control cost on capital projects in industrial, EPC, energy, and data center / mission-critical work. The role sets up and maintains the control budget, tracks commitments and actuals, measures earned value, forecasts the estimate at completion, and runs the trend and change management process from the first notice through to budget incorporation.



What the Role Does

Establish and maintain the control budget and cost breakdown structure; reconcile it to the estimate and the contract.

Track commitments, accruals and actuals; produce the monthly cost report and EAC / ETC forecasts with variance explanations.

Run the trend and change management process: identify trends early, log and price potential changes, route them for approval, and incorporate approved changes into budget and schedule.

Measure progress and earned value; report CPI / SPI and what is driving the forecast.

Review contractor pay applications and invoices against progress and contract terms; maintain the cash-flow forecast.

Maintain the change log, contingency drawdown and management reserve.





Qualifications: 

3 / 7 / 12 or more years in project cost control for the Specialist / Senior / Lead tiers.

Owned the monthly cost report, the EAC and the change log on live projects.

Experience in industrial / EPC / energy or data center / mission-critical projects.

AACE CCP, EVP or CCT, or PMP, preferred.

title: Microsoft 365 Security & Access Engineer
description:
Work setup: 100% remote, independent contractor

Schedule: Approximately 25 hours/week initially; some overlap with client business hours then 8 hrs/week ongoing support



The Opportunity



We are looking for a hands-on Microsoft 365 security and access engineer who can design and help implement a practical, secure information-sharing workflow. You will d
 who can access which information, who can approve access, how different organizations remain separated, and how access and actions are recorded. You will work with an existing technical team to launch a controlled pilot and hand it over with clear documentation.

We welcome applicants with backgrounds in Microsoft 365 engineering, Entra ID, identity and access management (IAM), cloud security, infrastructure engineering, or solutions architecture. Your demonstrated work matters more than your job title or certifications.



What You Will Deliver in the First Four Weeks:



Review the current users, information flows, permissions, and main security risks; agree on a realistic pilot scope with the team.

Design an access model for two or more organizations, including roles, approval rules, least-privilege permissions, and protected information boundaries.

Configure or guide Microsoft 365 / Entra ID controls for an initial
-based workflow, including groups, shared mailboxes, MFA, and appropriate access policies.

Define access changes for onboarding, role changes, temporary access, and offboarding, including revocation and audit records.

Document permissions for service accounts or AI agents where relevant, including actions that require human approval.

Test unauthorized-access scenarios, verify logs and revocation, resolve critical pilot defects with the team, and provide a usable handover.



Our Five Must-Haves:



Clear spoken and written English: understand questions, explain trade-offs simply, and communicate directly with a nontechnical stakeholder.

Proven personal ownership: show one live security, identity, or access-control solution you personally designed or materially architected, and explain exactly what you did.

Sound technical judgment: explain why you chose specific roles, permissions, scopes, tenant boundaries, or environments instead of simply listing technologies.

Practical Microsoft 365 / Entra ID and access-security experience: hands-on work with identity, MFA, groups, permissions, least privilege, and protecting information across teams or clients.

Problem-solving and delivery: investigate access failures or suspected exposure, test controls, work with developers, and complete a usable pilot with documentation.



Helpful, But Not Required:



Microsoft or other security certifications; ISO 27001 or SOC 2 exposure.

Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, automation, APIs, AI agents, or service identities.

Prior consulting or MSP work supporting multiple organizations.





What Success Looks Like

The pilot works, unauthorized users cannot cross defined information boundaries, access can be granted and revoked appropriately, actions can be traced, and the internal team can operate the setup after handover. Scope and acceptance tests will be agreed at kickoff to fit the contracted hours.



How We Interview

Be prepared to describe one system you personally designed, why you made its security decisions, and what you would do if a user could access another client’s information. We value clear thinking, practical examples, and honest answers over jargon.



To Apply:



Send your CV and a short description of one Microsoft 365 / identity-access project you personally designed or implemented. Include your specific responsibilities, technologies used, availability, and confirmation that the proposed hourly rate works for you

We operate approximately 5–7 US brands across food and retail. We’re looking for an experienced E-commerce & SEO Manager who can take ownership, solve problems, and grow our online sales.



Marketplace management will initially focus on our packaged-food brand, while website SEO responsibilities will extend across applicable brands.



This is not an entry-level role. We need someone with proven results who can contribute immediately. We provide business context and onboarding, but you must already know how to perform the work.



# Your responsibilities



- Manage Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Walmart Marketplace, and TikTok Shop.

- Resolve inactive or unpublished listings, catalog errors, pricing issues, inventory discrepancies, and seller support cases.

- Optimize product listings, including titles, descriptions, images, keywords, and variations.

- Audit and improve website SEO, including indexing, metadata, internal linking, technical issues, and content opportunities.

- Monitor traffic, conversions, and sales; identify opportunities and implement improvements.

- Coordinate promotions, launches, and
 automation with our social media manager.

- Keep product information, shipping settings, inventory settings, and promotions accurate.

- Maintain clear priorities and provide weekly reports showing completed work, results, blockers, and next steps.



# What we’re looking for



- Strong hands-on experience with Shopify and Amazon, plus experience with Walmart Marketplace and TikTok Shop.

- Proven SEO implementation experience—not just keyword research or familiarity with tools.

- Evidence of improving sales, conversion rates, search visibility, or marketplace performance.

- Strong troubleshooting skills and follow-through with platform support.

- Clear written English, reliable communication, and organized task management.

- Ability to work quickly across multiple brands while maintaining accuracy.

- Initiative: you identify problems, recommend solutions, and execute without repeated reminders.



Experience with US consumer brands, packaged food, and local SEO is valuable.



# Expectations



Within your first month, you should establish performance baselines, identify priority issues, resolve problems within your control, and implement a clear improvement plan.



We expect accurate, purchasable listings, documented SEO work, and measurable progress. Unsupported promises of guaranteed rankings or sales are not what we’re looking for.



This is a dedicated full-time individual role, not an agency or outsourced team arrangement. You must personally perform the work, be available during agreed hours, and disclose other commitments that could affect delivery.



# How to apply



Use this application subject line:



OWN THE GROWTH — [Your Name]



Include the following directly in your application message:



1. Your expected monthly rate in USD for 40 hours/week.

2. Your earliest start date and available working hours in US Eastern Time.

3. Your experience level with each: Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, and SEO.

4. Links to relevant work, explaining what you personally handled.

5. Two measurable results you delivered, including the timeframe and your specific actions. Redacted screenshots are welcome.

6. Your answer to: An Amazon offer becomes inactive after a major price change. What would you check first, and why?

7. Your current work commitments and confirmation that you will personally perform the work without outsourcing.



Applications without your rate, relevant work samples, and the requested answer will not be shortlisted.



Shortlisted candidates may complete a practical assessment.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours 



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision: 

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business. 



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us! 



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager 



Role Purpose 

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time. 



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events. 



What Success Looks Like 

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance. 



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts. 



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution. 



Primary Objectives 

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System 

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR 

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment 

Competitive Advantage 

 

Regular Work Activities 

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails) 

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking 

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy 

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates 

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track) 

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content) 

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs 

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates 

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates 

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals 

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP) 

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration 

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR 

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required 

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals) 

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement 

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets) 

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing) 

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type) 

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed 

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list) 

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches) 

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues) 

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers) 

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination) 

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests) 



Key Skills 

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth) 

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions) 

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation 

Organized project management across many ASINs 

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating) 

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes 

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops) 

 

People Contacts and Interactions 

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment) 

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes) 

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions) 

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment 



Role Requirements 

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred) 

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent) 

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents) 

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work 

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline 

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back 



How to Apply:

Click the link - 

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

title: : Detail-Oriented QA Assistant for Weekly Business Reports (Part-Time, Work From Home)
description:
Type: Part-time, ~10 hours per week to start · Pay: $2.00/hour to start, paid via Wise or PayPal (your choice) · Start: within 1–2 weeks



About the role

Dimona Business Systems (Arizona, USA) sells a weekly Competitor Intel Brief to local businesses — a one-page report showing a business owner what their five closest competitors are doing: prices, promotions, reviews, ads. An AI bot builds each brief from public sources. Your job is to make sure every brief is TRUE before it goes out.



This is a quality-control role, not sales or marketing. Same cycle every week: check the bot's work, fix what is wrong, send it for approval,
 it out. The system works because the steps never change — and the work is steady: same window, same hours, every week.



Your schedule: Our week runs on Arizona (USA) time, which is 15 hours behind Philippines time. The main work lands Monday morning Arizona time — late Monday night Philippines time, about 11 PM to 2 AM. You must be reliably available in that window every week.



What you will do

• Read each brief (about 20 minutes each) and verify every number against the live source: Google ratings, review counts, prices, promo pages, social media posts

• Catch the AI's mistakes: invented numbers, outdated prices, wrong competitors, reports about the wrong business

• Tell the bot exactly what to fix, in plain words, and re-check the fix

•
 finished briefs using our exact scripts — no freelancing on the wording

• Follow the checklist the same way every time. Boring is good. Boring means it worked.



What we are looking for

• You notice small errors other people walk past

• You write clear, plain English

• You are honest about what you could NOT verify instead of guessing

• You follow instructions exactly as written



You do NOT need: marketing experience, sales skills, or a degree. We train you on the tools. We cannot train "notices details" — you either have it or you don't.



How to apply

The first line of your application must be: EAGLE EYE (applications without it are not read — this is your first test).

Then tell us, in a few sentences: who you are, where in the Philippines you are based, and confirm you can work the late-Monday-night window every week.



Shortlisted applicants get a paid 20-minute audition (flat $5 via PayPal): a sample brief with planted errors. Find them. Most people miss half — that's the point.
