description:
Sandwicheez · Fully Remote · Part-Time · Restaurant / Food & Beverage



About Sandwicheez

Sandwicheez makes sandwiches the way they should be made: fresh bread, premium ingredients, generous builds, and a crew that cares. We started as a neighborhood shop in California and now operate six locations, with a clear mission:



Become the #1 sandwich chain in America within the next three years.



We’re a founder-led, fast-moving company led by an operator who has built 22 restaurants and three software companies. Good ideas get tested quickly, and results get noticed. The person in this role will help shape the brand that takes Sandwicheez from local favorite to national name.



The Opportunity

We’re hiring a Marketing Manager to own how Sandwicheez is positioned, communicated, and grown. You’ll define what our brand stands for, make sure our value proposition reaches the right customers, and lead our remote marketing team of six in the Philippines to turn attention into store visits, online orders, catering sales, and repeat customers.



Key Responsibilities:



Brand & Positioning

* Define and strengthen the Sandwicheez brand: who we serve, what makes us different, and why customers choose us over national chains.

* Communicate our value proposition clearly and consistently across our website, social media, in-store materials, delivery apps, and promotions.



Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising

* Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns on Meta, TikTok, and Google.

* Manage budgets and use performance data (CAC, ROAS, conversion rates) to improve results.

* Grow online ordering, catering, and our Cheez Club loyalty program.



Campaigns & Local Growth

* Build location-specific campaigns that attract new customers and drive repeat visits.

* Plan launches for new menu items, seasonal offers, meal bundles, and local events.



Team Leadership

* Lead a remote team of six covering social media, content, design, and SEO.

* Set priorities, delegate tasks, establish deadlines, and hold regular check-ins to keep the team accountable.

* Coordinate with leadership and store teams, track KPIs, and report results with clear recommendations.



What Success Looks Like

* 30 days: You understand our brand, customers, locations, and team, and have identified the biggest quick wins.

* 90 days: You’ve delivered a marketing plan with clear KPIs and launched campaigns with measurable results.

* 1 year: Sandwicheez has a sharper brand, a repeatable marketing playbook for new locations, and steady growth in traffic, digital sales, catering, and loyalty sign-ups.



Requirements:

Must Have

* Minimum 7 years of professional marketing experience, with significant hands-on work in digital marketing and brand development

* Proven track record in brand positioning and messaging that drove measurable business growth

* Hands-on experience planning, managing, and optimizing paid social and digital ad campaigns (Meta and/or TikTok preferred)

* At least 3 years leading or managing a team, including delegating, setting priorities, and following up on results

* Strong analytical skills with tools such as Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and reporting dashboards

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

* Self-motivated and organized, able to work independently in a fully remote environment



Strongly Preferred

* Experience growing online ordering

* Experience managing remote or offshore teams

* Experience supporting a brand through expansion into new locations or markets

/SMS marketing, review management (Yelp, Google), and influencer or community marketing

* Reports to: Founder / President

title: BOOKKEEPER/ BUSINESS MANAGEMENT STAFF
description:
## POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Business Management / Bookkeeping Staff member to provide day-to-day accounting and administrative support for one of our key clients. This position will work closely with the client and our accounting team to manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, commission reporting, financial records, and other business management responsibilities.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable communicating directly with clients, vendors, and employees.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



* Manage and maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Process vendor invoices, payments, and customer receipts.

* Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up on past-due balances.

* Maintain accurate vendor and customer records.

* Assist with cash flow monitoring and payment scheduling.



### Commission Reporting



* Prepare recurring commission reports and calculations.

* Review sales and transaction information for accuracy.

* Coordinate commission payments and resolve discrepancies.

* Maintain supporting documentation for commission calculations.



### Payroll



* Coordinate and process payroll information.

* Review payroll reports for accuracy.

* Maintain employee payroll records and assist with payroll-related questions.

* Coordinate with the payroll provider and accounting team as needed.



### Client Support



* Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for the client regarding accounting and business management matters.

* Respond to client questions and requests in a timely and professional manner.

* Coordinate with vendors, employees, and other third parties on behalf of the client.

* Identify issues and communicate them to the appropriate accounting or management team.



### Bookkeeping & Financial Administration



* Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.

* Maintain accurate and organized accounting records.

* Assist with monthly financial reporting and account analysis.

* Enter and review transactions in QuickBooks Online.

* Assist with budgeting, cash flow tracking, and other financial analysis as needed.



### General Business Management Support



* Handle miscellaneous accounting, business management, and administrative tasks related to the client's business.

* Assist with special projects and financial research.

* Maintain organized electronic records and supporting documentation.

* Coordinate with the tax and accounting teams regarding tax filings, information requests, and year-end matters.

* Take on additional responsibilities as needed to support the client's business operations.



## QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS



* Minimum 2 years of experience working with U.S.-based clients or accounts.

* 2+ years of bookkeeping, accounting, business management, or related experience.

* Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Experience with payroll and commission calculations preferred.

* QuickBooks Online experience preferred.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and organization.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial and payroll information.

* Strong client service and communication skills.



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is someone who can become familiar with the client's business and serve as a reliable day-to-day financial resource. This person should be proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.



## WHAT TO EXPECT



As a member of our team, you can expect:



* A welcoming and inclusive environment where your opinions and ideas are valued.

* Opportunities for personal and professional growth through ongoing training and development.

* Competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your family.

* Flexibility to achieve a work-life balance that suits your needs.

* An atmosphere that encourages innovation, creativity, and collaboration.

* Regular team-building activities and social events to unwind and build lasting relationships with your colleagues.



## WORK SCHEDULE



**Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (California time)**



## WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?



* Competitive salary, depending on experience

* 24 PTO credits

* Remote opportunity — work from the comfort of your home

* Long-term opportunity with career growth and advancement



## OUR BACKGROUND



We are a **U.S.-based accounting firm** committed to providing exceptional service and value to our clients. We believe our success starts with a strong, qualified team and a supportive company culture.



We value teamwork, professional growth, and a positive attitude. Our core belief is that **attitude is just as important, if not more important, than technical skills**, and we strive to create an environment where our team members feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow.

Role Overview



As a Sales VA, your main responsibility is to help turn new enquiries into booked calls, viewings, or qualified opportunities. You will be the first point of contact for many leads, so your communication needs to be clear, polite, confident, and persistent without being pushy.



You will work closely with the sales/property team to make sure every lead is followed up properly, logged correctly, and moved through the pipeline.



Key Responsibilities

- Lead Follow-Up

- Respond to new leads from
, website forms, WhatsApp, email, property portals, and CRM systems.

- Call, message, and email leads quickly after they enquire.

- Follow up with old leads who have not replied.

- Keep leads warm through polite and consistent communication.



Qualification

- Ask basic qualifying questions to understand the lead’s needs.

- Find out their property requirements, budget, location, timeline, and level of interest.

- Identify serious leads and pass them to the right team member.

- Filter out low-quality or unsuitable enquiries.



Appointment Booking

- Book calls, viewings, consultations, or meetings into the team calendar.

- Confirm appointments with leads.

- Send reminders before appointments.

- Follow up with leads who miss calls or do not attend booked meetings.



CRM Management

- Add new leads into the CRM.

- Update contact details, notes, lead status, and follow-up dates.

- Make sure no lead is left without a next step.

- Keep the sales pipeline clean and organised.



Communication Support

- Send professional messages to leads, tenants, landlords, investors, or clients.

- Use approved scripts and templates while still sounding natural.

- Escalate important questions or difficult situations to the sales/property team.

- Maintain a professional tone at all times.



Requirements



The ideal candidate should have:

- Strong spoken and written English with a direct tone.

- Previous experience in sales, appointment setting, customer service, or admin.

- Confidence making calls and speaking to new people.

- Good organisation and attention to detail.

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA (Keepa/SellerAmp)
description:
I run an established Amazon FBA/FBM online arbitrage business and I'm hiring ONE full-time sourcer for a long-term role. I want someone who has built, tested, and refined their OWN sourcing strategy using SellerAmp and Keepa, and can show it has been profitable. I'm not looking for someone to just follow a script.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- A defined, repeatable strategy you developed yourself

- Strong experience finding replenishable products (consistent sales, stable pricing, repeat demand) and well-timed seasonals

- I prefer storefront stalking, so experience there is a big plus. If your strategy uses other methods, tell me how they perform compared to storefront stalking.

- Deep SellerAmp and Keepa knowledge, used as a decision-making system, not just a profit calculator



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Source leads using your strategy, with storefront stalking as a core method

- Analyze every lead in SellerAmp and Keepa before sending it

- Check restrictions, gated brands, IP complaint risk, and private label/hijack risk

- Deliver leads in a Google Sheet: ASIN, buy link, cost, sell price, fees, ROI, profit, estimated monthly sales, rank trend, FBA seller count, and your reasoning for approving it

- Give me honest feedback on what's working so we can keep improving the criteria



REQUIRED

- 2+ years of real OA sourcing experience

- A strategy you built and tested yourself, with results to show for it

- Ability to explain WHY your strategy works, not just what steps it follows

- Honest reporting. If a lead is risky or a method isn't working, tell me.

- Excellent written English and reliable communication

- Consistent 40 hours/week availability



COMPENSATION

- $3-3.50/hour depending on experience, full-time (40 hrs/week)

- Raises as results are proven

- Paid test task first, then ongoing work if results hold up



EXPECTATIONS

- Daily output of 5+ verified leads. Quality over quantity: ten solid leads beat fifty weak ones.

- Weekly check-in to review results and adjust.



IMPORTANT

- You will NEVER have access to my Amazon account, payment methods, or bank details.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip this will be ignored)

Start your application with the word "DINIGUAN" and answer in your own words:



1. Describe your sourcing strategy from start to finish. How did you build it, and what did you test and change along the way?

2. How did you PROVE it was profitable? What did you measure (sell-through, actual ROI on purchased inventory, win rate of leads) and what were the results? Include screenshots, a sample lead sheet, or a past client/employer I can contact (hide private info).

3. How do you use storefront stalking in your strategy? How do you pick storefronts and d
 which products to source?

4. How do you find replenishables that sell at an efficient pace? What exact numbers do you look for in SellerAmp and Keepa?

5. How do you handle seasonals, including timing and avoiding leftover inventory?

6. What does your SellerAmp/Keepa checklist look like before you approve a lead? What makes you reject a product?

7. Tell me about a strategy or lead type that DIDN'T work, and what you learned.

About D2C



D2C is a shopper, field and brand marketing agency operating across Australia and New Zealand. 

We are looking for a reliable, detail focused Virtual Assistant to keep our website and social channels current, consistent and professionally presented.



The role

You will manage content publishing across our WordPress website, LinkedIn and Instagram, turning supplied copy and imagery into polished, approved posts.

Our target is three core content pieces per week, adapted across all three channels. This means approximately three website uploads, three LinkedIn posts and three Instagram posts, rather than nine separate pieces of original content.

Content will include case studies, company news, campaign highlights and industry insights.



Key responsibilities



WordPress content management

Upload, format and publish case studies, news and insights using our existing website templates. Prepare featured images, headings, links, categories and image alt text. Add basic SEO titles and descriptions where supported, optimise image sizes, and check desktop and mobile presentation before publishing.



LinkedIn and Instagram publishing

Adapt supplied content into captions suited to each platform and D2C’s tone of voice. Resize and crop imagery using existing assets and templates, add appropriate tags and links, and schedule or publish approved posts. Check that published content displays correctly.



Content coordination and quality control

Maintain a simple content calendar covering drafts, approvals and publication dates. Proofread all content, organise assets and flag missing information early. Obtain approval before publishing, particularly for client names, campaign results and imagery. Provide a brief weekly update with published links, outstanding items and time spent.



What we are looking for

• Proven WordPress publishing experience, including formatting articles, managing images and working within existing templates.

• Experience managing business LinkedIn and Instagram accounts, including adapting captions and scheduling organic content.

• Strong written English and attention to detail, with the ability to follow brand guidelines and use British/Australian spelling.

• Basic image editing skills, using Canva or similar tools, plus reliable communication and the ability to meet deadlines independently.



Experience supporting a marketing agency or other business audience would be an advantage. Coding and website development experience are not required.



Working arrangements and scope

The role is expected to require approximately six hours per week, with flexible scheduling and some availability during Sydney business hours for coordination.



D2C will provide core copy, imagery, brand guidance and approvals. Your focus will be publishing, light copy editing and adapting existing assets.



Original article writing, substantial graphic design, video production, paid advertising, ongoing community management and website development are outside the initial scope. Any additional work or hours must be agreed in advance.



How to apply

Please provide a brief introduction via video, your hourly rate and currency, time zone, weekly availability and relevant WordPress and social media examples. Explain your specific contribution to each example.

title: Podcast and Video Editor + Shorts Producer, Contemplative Podcast (Part Time, Long Term)
description:
About the show



House of Belonging with Laura Thomas is a new weekly podcast launching on 16 November 2026. Short, quiet episodes about the ordinary moments when a person comes home to herself. It is contemplative and gently Zen in spirit, never preachy and never salesy. Laura records on camera in her own room, so every episode goes out as audio, as a full YouTube video, and as short vertical clips.



We are looking for one editor to own the weekly production: the episode, the video, and the clips that bring new listeners to the show. This is a long-term role for the right person.



What you will do each week

1. Assemble each episode in Descript from Riverside's separate audio and video tracks: Studio Sound, filler and false starts removed, intro and outro music, chapter markers, and a clean export. This is a slow show. Natural pauses are part of it and stay in.

2. Edit the full episode video for YouTube, cutting between two camera angles.

3. Cut four vertical Shorts or Reels (30 to 90 seconds) from that week's recording, with captions checked word for word against what Laura actually says.

4. Draft six Substack Notes from Laura's published essays, in her voice, for her approval.

5. Make three Instagram posts in Canva from our templates: a carousel, a quote card and a photo post.

6. Research 12 to 15 podcasts a week that could host Laura as a guest, and add each one to our spreadsheet with its audience size, how you know that, how the show books guests, and a contact link.

7. There are three episode types: solo episodes of about 20 minutes, conversations with Laura's teacher, and interviews. 



Turnaround is 48 hours from raw files to finished episode and clips. Notes are drafted the same day they are requested.



What you need

1. At least two years of podcast editing, with links to episodes you edited

2. Strong Descript skills, including multitrack and video editing

3. A portfolio of vertical short-form clips with clean, accurate captions

4. Excellent written English, because you will draft text in someone else's voice

5. Canva, Google Drive and Google Sheets

6. Reliable internet and a backup plan for power or connection outages

7. Comfort with detailed feedback in the first month, while you learn how the show should sound



Nice to have

1. Experience with Riverside

2. An interest in meditation, mindfulness, poetry or contemplative writing

3. Experience growing a YouTube Shorts channel



Pay and hours

- USD $9 per hour, paid weekly through OnlineJobs.ph EasyPay

- About 12 hours a week for the first three weeks, then about 10 hours a week, ongoing

- Flexible hours and mostly asynchronous work. We are in US Mountain Time, with one short video check-in a week

- A 30-day trial, then a long-term contract



A paid test task: shortlisted applicants are paid USD $30 for a short test of about three to four hours. We pay everyone who delivers, whether or not we hire them



How to apply

- Start your application with the word "Threshold", so we know you read this far.

- Send links to two podcast episodes you edited, and say what you did on each.

- Send links to three vertical clips you cut.

- In two or three sentences, tell us what makes a 45-second clip from a slow, reflective conversation work.

- Tell us your earliest start date. We would like you to start on Monday 2 November.



We review applications on Thursday 29 October and contact the shortlist on Friday 30 October.

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.

This position requires AT LEAST 3 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. • Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support) as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

• We're closed on major US holidays, and at the completion of the first 3 months of employment, you'll qualify for paid holidays.

• Work hours are Mon-Fri at 8 am till 5:30 pm (UTC-07:00 , MST, Arizona time zone)

• Every 4 to 5 weeks, you'll be working 1/2 day on a Saturday (project work/catch-up work) and get 1/2 day off the week after

• Mandatory 1-hour lunch and additional breaks (as you need those) throughout the day.

• Further details and information will be discussed with qualified candidates.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Motion Graphics and Effects)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners. We are looking for an inventive, trend-savvy short-form video editor to create scroll-stopping, high-converting video for all of our brands.



You will turn raw phone footage from our in-house team and content creators into organic TikToks and Reels, product videos for Amazon, Chewy, and TikTok Shop, and paid social and Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.



You won’t just be cutting clips together. You will add creative flair, dynamic masking, kinetic transitions, and sound design to make simple clips feel clever and fun. You should be fluent in TikTok and IG culture, native trend formats, and creative visual editing tricks.



We work AI-first. You should already use AI features in your editing tools (for example, DaVinci Resolve Magic Mask or CapCut auto cutout) to work faster without lowering quality.



Pay: USD 1,500 to 2,000 per month, depending on experience

Schedule: 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM PST

Reports to: Creative Director. You will work day to day with our Social Media Manager and other marketing managers.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Organic Social Video (about 20 hours per week)



Edit 9:16 vertical videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels using raw footage from our in-house social team and content creators.

Apply creative visual effects, including dynamic rotoscoping and masking (sticker peel effects, freeze-frame cutouts, object pop-ins), seamless jump cuts, disappearing and appearing object tricks, match cuts, native collage, paper tear, 2D sticker animations, and seamless loops built for replay value.

Time cuts, transitions, text animations, and effects precisely to the beat of the music.

Design on-screen text with a refined eye: choose and pair fonts, set clear hierarchy and spacing, keep text within platform safe zones, and animate it so it looks polished and premium, not template-based.

Add trending audio licensed for business accounts, sound effects, animated captions, and platform-native text styles.

Bring your own ideas for hooks, pacing, and trend formats instead of only assembling footage.



Marketplace Video (about 10 hours per week)



Create product videos for Amazon (listing and A+ Content), Chewy, and other channels.

Adapt content to each platform’s formats, including 16:9, 1:1, and 9:16.

Follow each retailer’s content guidelines, with clear product benefits and demonstrations.



Paid Ads (about 15 hours per week)



Edit video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Amazon Sponsored Brands.

Produce multiple hook and format variations of each concept for testing.



AI Workflow



Use AI tools throughout your workflow to speed up turnaround, such as AI masking and rotoscoping, auto captions, beat detection, and rough cut assembly, while keeping full creative control of the final edit.

Generate and edit video and visual assets with AI tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, and Claude, and blend them with live footage.



Across All Work



Manage a steady weekly queue of requests from the Creative Director, Social Media Manager, and marketing managers.

Keep project files organized and deliver final exports in the correct specs for each platform.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



A portfolio of TikTok and Reels edits with creative transitions, masking, and visual tricks. Talking-head videos with subtitles will not be considered.

A precise sense of rhythm. Your edits land on the beat, not near it.

Strong typography and design sense, including font pairing, hierarchy, spacing, color contrast, and adapting text style to different brand identities.



Required



Working proficiency in both CapCut and DaVinci Resolve. Our team uses both for project handoffs.

Advanced motion graphics and effects skills in at least one professional tool, such as After Effects, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve (Fusion), or CapCut Pro.

Hands-on experience with AI video tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, or similar.

A strong ear for sound design and audio syncing.

Deep familiarity with current TikTok and Reels trends and humor formats.

Fluent written and spoken English for daily work with a US-based team.

Ability to manage a full weekly queue and meet turnaround times.



Nice to Have



Experience creating product videos for Amazon, Chewy, or TikTok Shop.

Experience editing paid social or Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.

Ecommerce or consumer products experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application through OLJ with:



Links to 3 to 5 short-form videos you edited that show creative transitions, rotoscoping or masking tricks, or seamless loops. At least one must show beat-synced editing, and at least one must show custom on-screen typography. For each link, add one sentence naming the effect or technique you built, the software you used, and whether it shows beat-syncing or typography.

Any product, marketplace, or ad videos you have edited, if available.

Your main editing and motion graphics software, the AI tools you use, and one example of how AI shortened your turnaround on a specific video.

Your current availability and typical turnaround time per video.

youtu.be/dO2mWWZANx8



At Summitree, we are building a global K-POP e-commerce business with a multicultural team from Korea, the Philippines, Mongolia, and other countries.

Our Filipino team members are an important part of our global growth. By joining Summitree, you will become part of an international team working together to grow HiDuckoo into a global K-POP brand.



[Who We Are Looking For]

K-POP Content Creator & Video Editor (On-Camera Role)

We are not looking for a Video Editor who only edits footage provided by others.

We are looking for someone who genuinely loves K-POP and can take ownership of the entire content creation process:



**Trend Research → Idea Generation → Scriptwriting → B-roll Research → Shooting → Video Editing**



You will create both short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts and long-form content for YouTube.

Your goal is to create engaging content that attracts new audiences, grows the HiDuckoo brand, and ultimately contributes to sales.



[Responsibilities]

1. K-POP Content Planning

Follow current K-POP trends, including new artists, comebacks, fandom topics, memes, albums, merchandise, and social media trends, and turn them into engaging content ideas.

You should be able to independently research a topic, develop an idea, write a script, and plan the necessary B-roll.

2. HiDuckoo Behind-the-Scenes Content

Create interesting content from our actual e-commerce operations, including:

- Purchasing and receiving K-POP albums and merchandise

- New product arrivals

- Order processing

- Packing and shipping

- Warehouse and day-to-day operations

- HiDuckoo team behind-the-scenes

You should be able to turn ordinary business activities into content K-POP fans will enjoy watching.

3. Video Editing

Create and edit:

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok videos

- YouTube Shorts

- YouTube long-form videos

Use B-roll, subtitles, music, sound effects, transitions, hooks, storytelling, and pacing to create engaging videos that keep viewers watching.

4. On-Camera Content

For some content (refer to our 
 you will film yourself and appear on camera.

You do not need to appear in every video, but you must be comfortable speaking to viewers and having your face publicly featured on the company's social media channels.



[Required Qualifications]

- Strong video editing skills using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software

- Ability to edit both short-form and long-form content

- Strong interest in K-POP and active understanding of current trends

- Ability to independently research and plan content

- Ability to research and use appropriate B-roll

- Comfortable filming yourself and appearing on camera



[Preferred Qualifications]

- Experience creating K-POP or social media content

- Experience running a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or K-POP fan account

- Understanding of hooks, retention, and storytelling

- Experience with Photoshop or Canva

- Experience in social media marketing or e-commerce

- Experience creating product or behind-the-scenes content

- Experience using AI tools such as Higgsfield, Seedance, ElevenLabs, Runway, CapCut AI, or similar tools in a content creation workflow



[Compensation & Benefits]

*Probationary Period: 6 Months

- Months 0–3: USD 250/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month, subject to satisfactory performance

The probationary period may be shortened for excellent performance.

*After Regularization:

- Base Salary: USD 300/month

- Guaranteed 13th Month Pay

- One-year contract renewal basis

*Performance & Salary Growth

Content performance matters. Meaningful growth in social media followers and/or sales on the HiDuckoo online shopping mall will be considered for performance incentives and salary increases.

Outstanding results may lead to an earlier salary increase.

*Benefits

- 10 additional paid leave days after regularization

- One K-POP album from your favorite artist on your birthday after six months of employment

title: Senior Creative Specialist
description:
Job Overview



The Senior Creative Content Specialist is responsible for developing and managing high-quality creative content across Life Interiors’ website, social media platforms, and YouTube channel. Working within a fast-growing, technology-leading organization with an amazing team culture, this role will play a key part in strengthening the Life Interiors brand and delivering engaging digital experiences to customers across multiple platforms. The successful candidate will take ownership of the creative process from concept through to execution, producing visually compelling content that reflects the brand’s identity, engages the target audience, and supports marketing and commercial objectives.

This is a senior creative role requiring strong visual judgement, excellent attention to detail, initiative, and the ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously.



Key Responsibilities:



● Develop creative concepts and visual content for the Life Interiors website, social media platforms, and YouTube channel.

● Create engaging graphics, campaign assets, promotional materials, lifestyle content, and digital advertisements aligned with brand standards.

● Manage and create visual content for social media platforms, ensuring content is consistent, engaging, and appropriate for each platform.

● Develop and edit short-form and long-form video content for YouTube, social media, website campaigns, and promotional activities.

● Create YouTube thumbnails, video graphics, titles, visual assets, and supporting creative content designed to improve engagement.

● Work closely with the marketing and wider business teams to develop creative campaigns that support product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and business objectives.

● Create and maintain website banners, promotional graphics, landing-page assets, and other digital creative content.

● Repurpose existing content into different formats suitable for the website, Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

● Ensure all creative output is visually consistent and aligned with Life Interiors’ brand identity and standards.

● Edit and enhance photography, lifestyle imagery, product imagery, graphics, and video content.

● Take ownership of creative projects from initial concept through to final delivery.

● Manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining a high standard of creative quality.

● Liaise with internal stakeholders to understand creative requirements and translate ideas into compelling visual content.

● Stay up to date with current creative, social media, video, and digital content trends and identify opportunities to improve the brand’s online presence.

● Review existing creative content and recommend improvements to increase engagement, consistency, and overall customer experience.

● Report progress and communicate project status with relevant team members.



About you:



● Senior-level experience in a creative, digital content, graphic design, social media, or similar role.

● Strong portfolio demonstrating creative work across websites, social media, and video/YouTube content.

● Highly proficient in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.

● Strong experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects or equivalent professional video-editing software.

● Experience creating content specifically for social media platforms and YouTube.

● Strong understanding of visual storytelling, composition, typography, branding, and digital design.

● Ability to turn creative ideas and briefs into high-quality finished content.

● Excellent eye for detail and strong understanding of brand consistency.

● Creative thinker who can generate fresh ideas while working within established brand guidelines.

● Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and make confident creative decisions.

● Strong time-management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

● Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and responding to changing priorities.

● Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

● 3D Max, SketchUp, or other 3D/design software experience would be a strong advantage.

● Experience within retail, furniture, interiors, e-commerce, or lifestyle brands would be highly advantageous.

● Great work ethic.

● Focused, disciplined, proactive, and highly organized.

● Keen attention to detail.



Training & Career Development:



● Comprehensive technical training and ongoing development opportunities.

● Career development and personal growth opportunities within a fast-growing, technology-leading organization.

● Opportunity to take ownership of Life Interiors’ creative presence across multiple digital platforms and contribute to the continued growth of the brand.



What We Offer:



* Lucrative salary offer to the right candidate

* 13th month performance based bonus paid in December

* Annual performance and salary review every June

* HMO with an additional dependent

* 10 days Vacation leave

* 5 days Sick leave

* 3 days additional PTO (Christmas day, New Year’s day, & Good Friday)

* Full-time day shift (9:00 am to 6:00 pm - Australian Eastern Daylight Time (AEDT))

* Permanent work from home set-up

title: Meta Ads Analyst (E-commerce) – Facebook Ads Performance & Creative
description:
We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe, spending on Meta ads every day. We're looking for someone with real Meta ads experience to review our ads, understand what's working and why, and help our manager d
 what to do next.



What you'll do:



Analysing our ads (around 75% of the role)

- Review our Meta campaigns across all our brands and track the numbers each week to spot trends

- Work out which ads and angles are working, which are dropping, and why

- Spot ad fatigue early, looking at frequency, CTR, CPA and ROAS across TOF, MOF and BOF ads

- When a brand drops, find the reason: the creatives, the hooks, the price, the offer, the product page or the competition

- Work with our manager to d
 which brands need new ads, what kind of ads to make next and which products to test



Product research (around 25% of the role)

- Use our custom internal tools to find new products for us to test (does all the research work for you)

- Keep a ranked list of the best products for us to launch next

- Find the best reference videos and image ads for our editors



The product research side is easy to learn, and we'll show you exactly how we do it. The ads side is where we need your experience.



Reporting

- A short daily report and a more detailed weekly report in Google Sheets



You should have:

- Proven experience with Meta Ads Manager, either running ads yourself or analysing them for a brand or agency

- A strong understanding of frequency, CTR, CPM, CPA and ROAS, and how they connect

- Experience with creative analysis: why an ad works, what makes a good hook and angle, and when an ad is fatiguing

- Understanding of TOF, MOF and BOF and how they behave differently

- E-commerce or dropshipping experience is a big plus

- Good with Google Sheets

- Clear written English, your reports need to be easy to read and act on

- Reliability: you show up every day and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $5/hour, 3 hours a day, 7 days a week (21 hours a week). This is a starting rate and we're very happy to increase it when the work is good

- Bonuses when your recommendations perform well

- Reliable, long-term work with flexible hours

- Room to grow into a bigger role as we scale

- A team that listens. We want your ideas on how the work could be done better



How to apply:

1. Start your message with "AD ANALYST" so we know you read this post

2. Tell us about your experience with Meta ads: what accounts you've worked on, roughly how much spend, and what your role was

3. Portfolio or examples of previous work

title: Settlements Officer, Australian Mortgage Broking (Part Time)
description:
THE ROLE

You own every loan from formal approval to settled and funded. You are the reason our clients settle on the

day we promised them.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Check every formal approval against the application and the client's credit proposal across 12 fields: loan

amount, rate, product, term, repayment type, interest only period, splits, offsets, redraw, LMI, fees and

securities. Flag every mismatch to the broker the same day, including ones in the client's favour.

2. Build and run a settlement timeline for each file. Count the working days to settlement against the lender's

turnaround on day one and escalate early if the numbers are tight.

3. Track loan documents from issue to return to certification. Chase lenders, solicitors and conveyancers

professionally and persistently.

4. Complete our 12 point pre settlement checklist no later than 5 business days before settlement.

5. On refinances, manage the discharge authority and payout figures, which are the critical path.

6. Confirm certificates of currency (lender noted correctly), funds to complete and conditions met.

7. Verify every disbursement account against the original source document, never against an
.

8. Keep our CRM (Salestrekker) updated in real time with clear file notes.

9. Handle post settlement admin: loan set up checks, client welcome and record keeping.

You will not give credit advice or make decisions for clients. Our Australian brokers own advice, client

decisions and lodgement. Your job is to make sure nothing slips.



MUST HAVES (APPLICATIONS WITHOUT THESE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED)

1. At least 2 years working on Australian residential home loans (broker, aggregator, lender or conveyancer),

with at least 1 year handling settlements or post approval.

2. You can clearly explain: conditional vs formal approval, discharge authority, LMI, offset vs redraw, and

what PEXA is.

3. Excellent written and spoken English. You will
 Australian lenders and solicitors directly.

4. Hands on experience with at least one of: Salestrekker, Mercury, MyCRM, ApplyOnline, or Australian

lender broker portals.

5. A proper home office: wired internet of 50 Mbps or more, a backup connection, a backup power plan, a

laptop with at least an i5 and 8GB RAM, webcam, noise cancelling headset and a quiet workspace.

6. Available Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 3:00pm Sydney time, 30 hours per week (6:00am to 12:00pm

Manila time from October to April, 7:00am to 1:00pm Manila time from April to October). No night shift, and

your afternoons are free.

7. You must be fully dedicated to us during those hours, and you must not work for any other Australian

mortgage broker or lender.

8. This is an independent contractor role. You must be registered with the BIR as self employed (or be willing

to register before you start) and able to issue BIR registered invoices.



NICE TO HAVES

Experience with PEXA, Notion or Loom. A Certificate IV in Finance and Mortgage Broking. Experience with

refinances, construction loans or SMSF lending.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. A fixed fee of AUD 1,000 per month (roughly PHP 40,000 or more, depending on the exchange rate).

2. Paid reliably within 7 days of your monthly invoice, by bank transfer or e-wallet.

3. Australian public holidays off.

4. Morning shift, 6 hours a day. No graveyard, and your afternoons are your own.

5. Structured onboarding with written SOPs and video training for every step.

6. A long term role in a growing team, with a clear path to Senior Settlements Officer as we scale.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

We receive a lot of applications. If you skip any step below, we will not read your application. This is your first

test of attention to detail.

1. Use this exact subject line: Settlements Officer | [Your Full Name] | T5

2. In the body of your message, answer these four questions in your own words. Short, specific answers are

best. AI generated answers are easy to spot and will be rejected.

a) A refinance settles in 12 business days. The outgoing lender has not acknowledged the discharge

authority after 4 days. What do you do, step by step?

b) Formal approval comes back with a rate 0.10% lower than the client was quoted. What do you do?

c) Two days before settlement, you receive an
 from the solicitor with new bank details for the

disbursement. What do you do?

d) Which Australian lenders and systems have you worked with, and how many settlements per month

were you personally handling?

3. Include a link to a video of 2 minutes or less (Loom, Google Drive or YouTube unlisted). Introduce yourself

and walk us through how you track a loan from formal approval to settlement.

4. Attach a screenshot of a speedtest.net result taken from your work desk.

5. Tell us your current work status, your notice period, any other work you hold, and whether you are already

BIR registered as self employed.

title: Creative Video Editor (Meta Ads, High-End B2B)
description:
We are seeking a high-caliber Creative Video Editor to develop and produce premium Meta video ads for a high-end physical product in the U.S. B2B space.



This role goes beyond basic cutting. We need a creative partner who understands performance marketing on Meta, knows how to speak to American B2B buyers and decision-makers, and can bring original, high-converting concepts to the table. The product is the hero. Every asset must reflect its actual scale, proportions, and build quality without looking cheap or gimmicky. AI and 3D tools may be used to enhance production value, but execution must remain realistic and polished.



What We Provide



We provide product photography and reference imagery. In many cases, you will need to build scenes and environments around the product yourself, so experience creating realistic settings from existing product assets is essential.



What You’ll Do



Concept & Direct: Develop original ad concepts with a strong hook in the first 3 seconds.

Execute & Composite: Produce clean, realistic video ads using compositing, 3D/CGI, or refined motion graphics.

On-Screen Typography: Design text overlays built for mobile and sound-off viewing. That means a clear type hierarchy, consistent fonts, proper line spacing, and uncrowded layouts that read instantly on a phone screen. Strong on-screen typography is non-negotiable for this role.

Product Consistency: Ensure the product maintains exact structural details, finish, and proportions across every shot and angle.

Iterate & Scale: Build creative variations (hook swaps, call-to-action changes, alternative framing) for ongoing performance testing.



What We Need From You



Familiarity with Meta advertising and an understanding of what makes ads perform.

Strong video editing and motion graphics skills, with experience in compositing or 3D tools (such as After Effects, Premiere, or Blender).

A strong eye for typography: hierarchy, spacing, and readability in motion.

Strict attention to visual detail and brand standards.

Ability to work on tight deadlines with quick turnaround.

A collaborative approach: open to feedback, comfortable with multiple rounds of revisions, and willing to share your own ideas.



To Apply



Start your application with “CREATIVE TESTING.”



Please provide:



3 to 5 of your top product-focused video ads (Meta B2B or direct-to-consumer preferred).

1 example showing how you maintained exact product accuracy across different environments or composite angles.

1 example of your on-screen text and typography work.

A brief explanation of how you develop hooks and maintain product accuracy.

Your typical turnaround time per ad concept and revision availability.



Please send only direct links to your most relevant work, not a full portfolio.
